A surfing collision results in a deep water spinal rescue. Mouse, AKA 'The Black Cloud' lives up to his nick name when he rescues a man with no pants, gets kicked in the face, and is then vomited on. And lifeguards try catch a rat that's been eating through the electrical cables on their buggies.

In the chaos of massive waves at Bondi's north corner, a bodyboarder in his 70s gets sucked out, and it's up to ex-pro surfer and Bondi's only female lifeguard, Nicola Atherton, to attempt the most dangerous rescue of her career. Additionally, a tragic spinal injury leaves the lifeguards in shock.

Harry loses his temper with three swimmers he warned not to swim in a dangerous area, leading to trouble with boss Hoppo, who decides to test lifeguards' customer service skills with a secret "mystery shopper" on the beach. Comedian and actor Rob Shehadie plays an annoying wannabe lifeguard - Steve.

Huge waves hit Bondi, leading Bisho to perform a cliff-face rescue with just flippers and a rescue tube. Trainee Taco faces consequences for rookie errors but earns redemption with the rescue of the season as a woman is caught beyond the waves in enormous surf.

As the season concludes, lifeguards play a final prank on trainee Harrison, enlisting football star Alessandro Del Piero to break the 'no ball games' rule. Nicola faces her fear of open water when a boat sinks off Bondi. Lifeguards build unique boats for their annual wave-riding contest.

FBI agent Robert Hanssen's treachery has been called the worst breach of U.S. intelligence in the history of the FBI. Plus, WorldCom executives fix the company's accounting numbers for their own personal game, causing the collapse of the telecommunications giant.

Jack Abramoff is one of the most successful U.S. lobbyists in history. However, his tactics aren't quite legal. Plus, the chairman of Daewoo is charged with masterminding accounting fraud worth 41 trillion dollars.

A rogue broker whose unauthorized speculative trading causes the spectacular collapse of Barings Bank. Plus, seven-time Tour de France winner Lance Armstrong is accused of doping and stripped of everything, including his once unconditional admiration.

Hours after robbing a bank in Waco, Nebraska, the 19-year-old culprit brags about it on YouTube along with her shocking reasons for doing it. Plus, a promising biopharmaceutical company goes from biotech sweetheart to stock market predator.

A marriage plagued by resentment and affairs hits it's tipping point and ends in a gruesome murder. Plus, a surgically precise and digitally orchestrated heist known as 'Unlimited Operation' drains banks of nearly $45 million globally – all within a few hours.

A Sri Lankan billionaire is arrested for insider trading as part of the largest ever-SEC case against a hedge fund. Plus, 'The Wolf of Wall Street' makes millions running a boiler room as part of penny stock scam that defrauds over 1,500 clients.

One morning a troubled Royal Canadian Mountie officer hits the tipping point and snaps killing one of his own. Plus, the son of a Las Vegas judge robs 1.5 million from the Bellagio Casino, dressed in full biker gear. The Biker Bandit's downfall? Pure stupidity.

A website posts explicit photos of people, without their permission, and demands payment to remove them. This extortion is called 'Revenge Porn'. Plus, 'El Chapo' runs one of the world's largest drug trafficking organizations in the world, until he is captured.

Vicente Fuentes rules his cartel with a bloody grip, responsible for mass murders and billions in drug trafficking. Plus, one of the most popular and longest serving U.S. mayors is accused of running a corrupt criminal enterprise.

Up and coming actress, Alexandra Ducsay, is murdered in her own home. For years this cold case goes unsolved until a key piece of evidence resurfaces years later. Plus, the downfall of a prominent leader of the pro-independence movement that sought to establish statehood for Taiwan.

Kicking off the season with an Unconventional Materials Challenge, Heidi and Tim welcome the designers at a Season 15 launch party. The designers are shocked to learn that the decor for the party will also serve as their materials for their looks. Savannah Guthrie joins the judging panel.
The designers must create an outfit to flatter all body types, and the challenge proves to be more difficult for some than others. Guest judge Nina Dobrev joins.

The designers have to create a look that sparkles not only in daylight, but also under blacklights on the Runway. Anxieties rise when the unusual materials leave many of the designers in the dark. Jamie King joins the judges this week.

In the season's first Team Challenge, the designers exercise their business savvy when they pitch their collection ideas to raise money from a group of mystery investors. The stakes are raised when they learn that the winning team members will each receive $5,000, and the winner will be featured in Marie Claire magazine!

The designers are excited to attend a press event, but their festive mood is quickly spoiled when the party turns out to be a challenge. The misdirect proves to be more than most of the designers can handle, as many of them have to start their looks over completely when criticized by a disappointed Tim Gunn. Emily Ratajkowski joins the judging panel.

The exhausted designers are whisked away to Universal Studios Orlando to recharge their batteries with a roller coaster or two. They are then challenged to find inspiration from their experience at the theme park to design a look for the “Urban Jungle.” Guest judge Rebecca Minkoff joins.

The designers are faced with their second Team Challenge of the season and must work together to create 3-piece collections to be shown in a SoHo pop-up shop. Eli and the Shane Gang have vanquished Dr. Blakk. But a new threat emerges from beyond the 99 caverns.
The Dark Slinger and his marauders have invaded Slugterra! But there's more to this new threat than meets the eye. Eli must fight a very different kind of duel to save Slugterra...and himself.

A new member joins the Shane Gang! His name is Junjie, and he is a master of the mysterious slugslinging art of Slug Fu. But even with the power of five slingers, the Shane Gang find themselves in over their heads trying to protect the ancient Elemental Slugs.
The Shane Gang and Junjie race across the 99 caverns to keep the Elemental Slugs out of the hands of the Goon.

programmes.st: The Journey to the Eastern Caverns
programmes.d: Eli and the Gang find a way to take Junjie back home to the Eastern Caverns-and find a whole bunch of trouble waiting for them when they get there!

Upon returning to the Outlaws' jungle camp, the Shane Gang suffer a sneak attack from the Emperor's Underlord Holt, who steals almost all of their slugs and loads them onto the Dragon Train for transport to the Emperor. With precious few slugs to use as ammo, the Shane Gang must be extra resourceful to get them back.
In order to reach the Emperor of the Eastern Caverns, Eli and Junjie pose as Underlords to enter the Tournament of Underlords.
In a climactic battle, Junjie and Eli confront the Emperor and the Dai-Fu as the fate of the entire Eastern Caverns hangs in the balance!

While Junjie struggles with the knowledge of what he did during his time as the Dark Slinger, the Shane Gang meet a former servant of the Emperor who wants to turn over a new leaf. But can the Shane Gang help a bad guy learn to do good?

When the Shane Gang arrive at a cavern overrun by thieves terrorizing the good townfolk, they decide to use Pronto as bait, hoping the thieves will eliminate each other as each strives to be the first to capture the valuable molenoid-the only one the Eastern Caverns have ever seen. However, their plan goes awry when Underlord Holt arrives and commands the thieves to work together to bring him Pronto-dead or alive!

programmes.st: Schubert - Symphony No. 9 in C major, D 944
programmes.d: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Franz Schubert's Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D. 944. Also known as The Great, is the final symphony completed by Schubert. Unusually long for a symphony of its time, a typical performance of The Great lasts around one hour. The work was found to be very difficult for orchestras of the day because of its extremely lengthy woodwind and string parts. This performance is recorded at St. Luke's, London on January 7th, 2021.

To convince the dance-averse Huckleberry to attend the big masquerade ball at the dog park, Blueberry promises she'll stay by his side the whole evening and make sure he doesn't have to dance. But as the day of the ball dawns, Blueberry awakens with a bad cold. She doesn't know how to tell Huck that she can't go to the ball. Lemon and Raspberry misinterpret her sniffles, thinking she's so heartbroken to be disappointing Huck that she's crying!

programmes.st: The Berry Biggest, Berry Baddest Bakeoff
programmes.d: Berry Bitty City is abuzz as Berrykin Bloom introduces the biggest, juiciest, strangest fruit anyone has ever seen! It's the size of a house, shaped like a strawberry, colored like a watermelon and has a spiky pineapple top. "I call it the sparklestrawwaterpineberry!" says Berrykin Bloom. Princess Berrykin declares it the greatest achievement in Berryculture she's ever witnessed.
Lemon and Raspberry hire twins Sweet & Sour to help out in Strawberry's café, so Strawberry will have time to appear in an internet fashion contest.

Strawberry's world-traveling cousin Apple Dumplin' stops at Berry Bitty City. What starts as a brief visit becomes a series of comical misadventures that ends with Apple finding a new home with Strawberry and her friends.

Lemon and Raspberry's fashion podcast is saved by Apple, then almost sabotaged by Sweet and Sour when Lemon's "mood hair" runs amok, acting like the bickering twins, and the twins' comical argument is accidentally broadcast on the "berrynet."

When Sour wishes she could have a birthday all her very own, her twin sister Sweet grants her wish by forgoing celebrating her birthday. But what begins as a day that Sour has always dreamed of quickly becomes a disappointment when she misses her twin. With Strawberry's help, Sour gives her birthday back to Sweet with a special surprise.
When a comedy of errors causes Orange, Plum and Cherry to arrive late to their campout, they start off their annual tradition of telling tall-tales around the campfire.

At the girls' campout, Sour launches into a whopper of a yarn about the adventures she and Sweet had in the "Berry Deep Dark Forest." She tries to get Sweet to participate in spinning the tale, but Sour's over-the-top performance leaves Sweet behind. Toward the end, Sour graciously changes the story to pull Sweet into it, giving Sweet the opportunity to toss in an ad lib that makes a nice topper to Sour's story.

Apple isn't paying attention when Strawberry describes their campout tradition of telling "Tall Tales." So Apple tells her thrilling adventure of a wild road rally she entered, only to surprise the girls by proving the story is actually true.

Apple's rave review on her berryweb page of Strawberry's new dessert starts a booming mail order dessert business for Berry Bitty City. When Strawberry's stuffed-up nose makes her bake a bad-tasting cake, Apple, afraid the truth will hurt Strawberry's reputation, proclaims it's delicious. The fib snowballs when the Queen of Berryvania reads Apple's review and orders Strawberry's new cake for her ball.

Sour teasing Apple escalates into a "prank war" between the two of them. After the girls' feud disrupts the town, they are sentenced in a Berry Bitty City-style trial to camp alone together for a whole weekend. Miraculously, they emerge best buds, and their friends are relieved, until Sour's influence on Apple turns her into a mini-Sour, and they have to do a personality "makeover" on Apple.
Berrykin Bloom's braggart cousin, Berrykin Bertram, has won the hot sauce competition at the local county fair year after year.

When Apple feels left out of a Berryball game and an advanced ballet class, she invents some "groove booties" programmed to dance to any beat. She temporarily impresses her friends with her dance moves, but when the groove booties go out of control and threaten the town's Berryball game, she is forced to fess up.

When the girls discover that Apple's groove booties can teach the pups to dance, Plum gets an idea for a Doggie Dance Show. Wanting to impress them, Huck offers to have TomTom join the show... despite the pup's obvious dislike of performing in public. It's up to Strawberry to help Huck see that he should not force TomTom into something he just doesn't want to do.

After recovering from injuries sustained in the mob attack upon himself and his creation, Dr. Frankenstein (Colin Clive) falls under the control of his former mentor, Dr. Pretorius (Ernest Thesiger), who insists the now-chastened doctor resume his experiments in creating new life. Meanwhile, the Monster (Boris Karloff) remains on the run from those who wish to destroy him without understanding that his intentions are generally good despite his lack of socialization and self-control.
Van Helsing (Peter Cushing) drives a stake through the heart of a vampire baron (David Peel) who even bites his own mother (Martita Hunt).

Two bicyclists are run down by a strange black car in the desert near a small town in Utah. But this is just the first in a series of hit-and-run murders. Sheriff Wade Parent is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett, is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren, are endangered.

Remnants of a mysterious animal have come to light in a remote jungle, and a group of scientists intends to determine if the find is an anomaly or evidence of an undiscovered beast. To accomplish their goal, the scientists (Antonio Moreno, Richard Carlson, Richard Denning, Whit Bissell) must brave the most perilous pieces of land South America has to offer. But the terrain is nothing compared to the danger posed by an otherworldly being that endangers their work and their lives.

Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

After Chuckie wets the bed one night, the Rugrats decide that Chuckie has to have a boring day so he won't have an exciting dream and forget to wake up and go potty./After the Rugrats see home movies of Stu's scouting days, they decide to be scouts.

When Chuckie rips his shirt, Chas buys him a new one, leading Chuckie to think he's not the same person and start going by the name "Ralph."/When Didi hides the cookie jar from Grandpa , Angelica convinces the babies to search for it.

When the babies can’t get Dil to sleep, Chuckie dreams they’ve all shrunk to the size of his toy figures—except for Dil. Meanwhile, Angelica graduates from charm school and tries to prove her new manners.
Feeling ignored, Tommy pretends to be sick like Angelica to get attention. But when things go too far, Dil notices Tommy in trouble and steps in to save him.

programmes.st: No Place Like Home Pt. 1/No Place Like Home Pt. 2
programmes.d: The babies and Angelica visit Susie in the hospital when she goes to get her tonsils removed. As Susie goes under, she dreams she has entered a strange, magical land, but she just wants to get home. She is joined by the Rugrats along the way.
As the seasons change from spring to winter, Angelica tells the babies that change isn't always a good thing; Betty gives Chuckie's dad advice on attracting ladies.
The Rugrats get rid of all their Reptar toys when they think it's why Grandpa moved out; Chuckie's dad has recently been on dates with some unusual women.

programmes.st: Doug's Huge Zit/Doug Flies A Kite
programmes.d: Doug was looking forward to Beebe's party, until something shows up that makes it impossible for him to go out in public. Phil Funnie convinces Doug that he has a great idea for a kite to compete in the upcoming Bluffscout airshow.

programmes.st: Doug and the Weird Kids/Doug's Behind the Wheel
programmes.d: Doug is paired with the weird twins Al and Moo Sleech for the class project of "Get to Know your Fellow Student." Judy is getting her license, and Doug tells Patti that she'll take them to the amusement park.

programmes.st: Where Have All The Monsters Gone?
programmes.d: The scare meter and hall of records informs the Gromble that monster scares are not as effective as they used to be in the human world.  This poses a problem to the monster race as it exists.
He's Baaaaaaack!  The relentless Simon the Monster Hunter is up to his old trick with new traps.  Gromble's students think he's all wet when he tells them about their legacy--the Pool of Elders.

Ickis is diagnosed as spontaneously combustible which means he could explode at any moment. His friends feel sorry for him, but at the same time are reluctant to be near him for fear that he could "go at any moment."

programmes.st: The Day the Earth Got Really Screwed Up
programmes.d: The Beavers trick-or-treat the scary house on the hill. It turns out to be the home of their B-movie star hero, Oxnard Montalvo. They discover the house is being taken over by a glowing space object that thrusts them into a wild movie.

programmes.st: My Bunny Guard / What's Eating You?
programmes.d: Daggett decides to be Big Rabbit's friend since he is feared and attempts to use him as his personal body guard. All is well until Big Rabbit wants to cash in on the friendship promise and turns Dag into a beaver football.

Hungry for adventure, Eliza concedes a plan to take a llama over the Andean pass, meeting her family on the other side of the mountain.  However, she is disappointed when her safety-conscious father commandeers the lead.

With Nigel and Marianne off exploring bat caves, Eliza and Debbie are left at the eerie residence of Nigel's colleague, Dr. Renfield.  Eliza becomes obsessed with spooking Debbie, when her imagination gets the best of her and the tables are turned.

When Eliza discovers that a local performer claims he can talk to animals she believes she's found a soul mate.  Eliza must enlist the help of some very urban animals to help her sneak into the sideshow and meet The Great Bangaboo.
Eliza convinces a group of Baboon-like apes to stand up against their legendary adversaries- The Others.  Darwin, meanwhile, has met an almost identical group of apes with an identical problem.
Gerald gets in over his financial head selling a sure-fire product.

AKA — Trash Can Day, Arnold and Gerald must get through the traditional day of hazing 4th graders./After Eugene's pet fish is accidentally killed by Arnold's yo-yo, Arnold vows to get unlucky Eugene a pet that will endure.
Arnold and the rest of his fourth grade friends play the seemingly unbeatable fifth graders in touch football. In the end, the fourth grade smarts win over the brute strength of the fifth graders.
Arnold and Gerald catch a suspicious man on film, and they follow him clue-to-clue.In an effort to win a class poetry contest, Phoebe copies a poem from a book.
Helga experiences a day free of her love/hate obsession Gerald reveals he can't ride a bike, and Arnold helps him overcome his fear and humiliation.
Phil falls for the captain of the school soccer team. Meanwhile, Vice-Principal Pangborn asks Dil, Tommy, and Chuckie to hang around with his nephew, who turns out to be irritating and annoying.
The Rats and their mothers embark on a cross country trip in a beat up R.V. to bring Susie to New York, where she's been selected to perform in a Thanksgiving parade.
Tired of being considered a goody two shoes by the popular kids, Susie tries desperately to prove that she can be a bad girl. Meanwhile, Phil discovers that he has a talent for cooking.

When Tommy forgoes the traditional opening day ball game outing with his Grandpa, Lou takes Dil instead. This makes Tommy jealous as he and Dil compete to be Grandpa's favorite grandson during a fishing trip.
When Chuckie discovers that Kimi is upset, he gets the gang to help him redesign her room. It turns out that she is homesick for Japan and misses her biological father.
When the gang looks for Halloween costumes in the Finster's basement, they find TP+KF carved on the wall. Chuckie is furious that Tommy might like Kimi and their friendship is put to the test.
When the comic book starring Chuckie's favorite superhero gets canceled, he is too depressed to help Tommy with his science fair project. The gang tries to find Chuckie a new hero to worship.

programmes.st: What's Love Got to Do With It?
programmes.d: Angelica falls in love with a handsome sub teacher. She tries to date him by failing her assignments. Meanwhile, Tommy, Phil, and Chuckie are part of the tennis club run by Pangborn and Chuckie is afraid to shower in the locker room.

The boys have the fight of all fights and decide to move out. James ends up squatting in a cool retiree’s apartment, Logan moves into a place right by the water, Carlos builds a cardboard house, and Kendall must fix things.

Big Time Rush has just dropped their second album and the guys get interviewed on an entertainment tonight-type program where they answer revealing questions about their life inside and outside of Big Time Rush.

It's BTR's final stop on their world tour and we go behind the scenes and see all the craziness that happens backstage. Mixing in real concert footage, we see the guys prepare for the show and deal with backstage drama.

The boys return from their world tour and are now famous at the Palm Woods, but they just want to get settled and focus on girls. Griffin tries to bribe Carlos to pick his favorite song for the boys’ upcoming radio interview.

BTR is too famous to be living at the Palm Woods, so Gustavo moves them to Bel Air. However the rules that come with upscale living don’t agree with the guys and they plot their grand escape back to the Palm Woods.

Its date night at the Palm Woods. James helps Carlos on his date with one of the Jennifers, Kendall joins Lucy’s dinner with her parents, and Logan takes a blind date out so he can spy on Camille's date with Jett.
Josh gets a student teaching job in Miranda's classroom, and Drake potentially discovers his new drummer.
Drake gets in trouble at school and is assigned to mentor a young boy.  But when Drake's new "little sibling" likes Josh more than Drake, we discover that brotherly love hurts.
When a crime show decides to film reenactments at the Premiere, fantasy and reality collide as Josh uproariously finds himself cast as the lead.  San Diego's most wanted Movie Bandit!
Drake decides that he and Josh are going to be the first to ride the Demonator, the fastest and scariest rollercoaster opening tomorrow at Mystic Mountain.
When Drake and Josh decide to turn the tables and prank little Megan, she has the whole family believing that aliens are coming.
In our season finale, Drake and Josh go on the Dr. Phyliss Show and relive some of their most outlandish moments. Some will jab at your funny bone, while others will tug on your heart strings.
When True has to design gear for skateboard phenom Ryan Sheckler, she and Lulu go undercover as boys to Ryan's all-boy skate club to do a little research.
After a dress she designs for a celebrity is trashed by a Joan Rivers-like interviewer, True devises a clever plan to get a do-over.
Max's fashion nemesis tries to lure True to come work for him.
True Gets in trouble with Mad Style's accountant when she overspends with her company credit card.
Max turns the office into a jungle for a day-long round of trust exercises and team-building.

Nickelodeon's first spin-off series, Kenan & Kel, is a buddy comedy starring Kenan Thompson and Kel Mitchell from All That.  These two friends dauntlessly chase after things most teenagers dream about, but few dare to pursue.

Nickelodeon's first spin-off series, Kenan & Kel, is a buddy comedy starring Kenan Thompson and Kel Mitchell from All That.  These two friends dauntlessly chase after things most teenagers dream about, but few dare to pursue.

Roger and Sheryl leave Kenan in charge one weekend when they leave town.  Kyra is already at her grandmother's so the rules they leave for Kenan are simple: don't make a mess and take care of his father's beloved cockatoo, Twizzles.  Within an hour of the

Pair-Rental Guidance: Kenan panics when the principal calls for a meeting with his parents.  When Kel jokingly suggests he hire two actors to portray his parents for the principal's benefit, Kenan puts the plan into effect.

Griffin is pitching a line of BTR merchandise to the CEO of Selmart, but the boys hate the products. Taking matters into their own hands the guys crash the meeting and accidently get their music banned from Selmart stores.
Kendall and Lucy are about to have their first kiss when her good looking ex-boyfriend Beau shows up to win her back. Griffin recruits Logan and Carlos to help him prepare for corporate espionage.
Kendall is ready to ask out Lucy, but Jo unexpectedly shows up and Kendall has to decide which girl is the one for him. Meanwhile Carlos and James’ friendship is put to the test.

Kendall and Logan must take care of Rocque Records' newest artist – an out-of-it rock legend until his induction into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame that night. James and Carlos are stuck babysitting Katie.

The guys want to go camping, but Gustavo nixes the idea because it’s dangerous. Instead they use their connections to camp on a sound stage, but things go awry as the guys try to show off their roughing it skills.
With their parents out of town and Megan planning a trip to Denver, Drake and Josh find they'll have the house to themselves for the week.

Andromeda is boarded by a drone from the Consensus of Parts, a mythical mechanical society. While friendly at first, the drone tries to force the ship to join the Consensus.

programmes.st: Fear and Loathing in the Milky Way
programmes.d: Gerentex is back and demands Trance and Harper help him with his new scheme: finding Tarn-Vedra.
Dylan and Rev Bem help a peaceful society stand up to their would-be slavers. They have to be careful because if Dylan teaches them to kill, their kids will be born knowing it.
Dylan attempts to bring peace to two different Nietzschean prides by escorting the princess of one to her arranged marriage to the prince of the other.
Rommie's avatar falls in love with what turns out to be the avatar of a warship named Gabriel. Gabriel attempts to infect Rommie with a virus that broadcasts its plans to the warship.
Beka takes the Andromeda to Tarn-Vedra, but extended time in the slipstream causes side effects. To combat them, Beka starts taking Flash and soon becomes addicted.
An old memory from the Andromeda is accidentally activated, which sends her on a mission and leaves Dylan and the crew unable to override the command.
With the Andromeda damaged by their deadliest enemies, Dylan and Rommie must rescue Tyr, Harper, and Rev from a Magog World ship.
Dylan, Beka, Rev, and Tyr crash land after escaping a gang of Nietzscheans, but soon face a new threat: Rev's need to feed.
The crew must steal a jewel that is at the center of a feud between a Drift owner and the Than. Beka falls for a security chief who was formerly a thief.
Andromeda answers a distress call when a cargo ship is attacked. Meanwhile, Trance is interrogated after paying a visit to the people.

programmes.st: Last Call at the Broken Hammer
programmes.d: The crew looks for a long-lost Commonwealth leader who has gone into hiding. They find her, but one question remains: is it actually her?

The crew is separated: Dylan, Beka, and Trance go with Rommie to find out about a new weapon being developed on a planet that is distrustful of AI; Harper, Tyr, and Rev struggle for survival when the Maru crashes into the ocean.
Andromeda is tasked with escorting medical ships safely through Drago-Kazov space.
A planet of Commonwealth survivors, led by Dylan's former fiance, is invited to join the new Commonwealth, but when they vote not to join, the Magog are suspected of playing dirty.
An agent of the Abyss tries to lure Harper into joining the Magog.
When they rescue a young prince from an uprising that kills the rest of his family, Dylan and Tyr are asked to be his advisers.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Find Polpo's Fortune!
programmes.d: While word of the high-ranking capo Polpo’s alleged suicide sparks astonishment and speculation in the crime syndicate Passione, Giorno is inducted into Bucciarati’s eclectic mafia family. The only problem now is the vast fortune seemingly up for grabs.

Sailing to the Isle of Capri to recover Polpo’s estate, Bucciarati and team are ambushed by a stealthy enemy Stand that deflates them into rubber-like human pelts. Abbacchio, however, thinks he can find his comrades and reluctantly activates his Stand.

Having beheaded their captor by zipper, the team learns its plan has been leaked to Zucchero’s cohort, who is lying in wait on Capri. With fish and gun, Giorno and Mista swim to the island to beat the boat and weed out their assassin-in-waiting.

As Mista closes in on Sale, all signs seem to point to an easy kill. If only it weren’t for the truck hurtling up a mountainous Capri road stuck to his hand or Sale’s power to freeze all objects, gunman Mista would be celebrating over his enemy’s corpse.

programmes.st: The First Mission From the Boss
programmes.d: Within arm’s reach of Polpo’s fortune, Bucciarati and team meet the unassuming Pericolo, a capo who has come to accept the treasure. In presenting the loot, Bucciarati is bestowed not only the rank of capo but also an immense duty: protect Trish Una.

After an encounter with the Hitman Team’s Formaggio, Narancia is left wondering why the world is quickly transforming around him. Narancia hunts down his assailant with a hail of bullets as Formaggio tries to understand his attacker’s tracking skills.

Narancia is unshakable as he uses firepower and CO2 detection to survive Formaggio’s body-shrinking attack. Even beneath a spider’s fangs inside Formaggio’s bottle, Narancia reveals not Trish’s whereabouts but the bullet holes his Stand has left behind.

programmes.st: The Second Mission From the Boss
programmes.d: Giorno, Abbacchio and Fugo travel to Pompeii to find a hidden key pivotal in their protection of Trish. Facing the trio, however, is more than the lonely remains of ancient Roman villas and colonnades. Fugo spots an odd figure in an even stranger mirror.
As the battle with the Deep Sea King reaches its climax, more heroes fall to the aquatic despot's brutal attacks.
Saitama tags along to an emergency meeting of Class S heroes and discovers that a seer has foretold a serious danger threatening the Earth.
As a colossal spaceship floats in the skies above City A, a member of its monstrous crew battles on the ground against a group of S-Class heroes.
The inconceivably powerful Lord Boros has traveled untold distances in search of someone who can cure his boredom: Saitama!
Seeing the state Yuki is in, Kaname takes her from Zero, who is left speechless when he realizes what he has done.
A new ethics teacher, Toga Yagari, arrives at Cross Academy.
Zero tried to sink his fangs into Yuki, but he was able to get hold of himself just before he succumbed to his urge.
Yuki makes a secret decision regarding Zero, who is now determined to fight his affliction until the very end. Yuki feels guilty for betraying Kaname and keeping a secret from him…
With a second Kira now on the loose, L asks Light to join the task force and pose as the real Kira in order to catch the copycat.
Light goes to Aoyama to discover the identity of the second Kira before L becomes more suspicious.
Light and Misa show each other their Death Notes, and Light asks Misa to have her shinigami Rem get rid of L.
Evidence turns up that points to Misa Amane as the second Kira.
Misa is in confinement, though her memories of the Death Note have been completely wiped away.
After fifty days of confinement the killings continue, and Misa and Light are released.
Ibara is critically injured after getting caught in a blast caused by the 1st Division’s tank.
While heading to the hospital, Ibara and her team run into Cleanup Crew members Kanon and Shion Ozu, otherwise known as the Ozu Sisters.
Haruto informs the group that a massive and lethal Zone is approaching the Planet.
The Coppelion set their escape plan into motion by dividing into two teams, with the Diversion Team led by Ibara.
The Diversion Team find themselves in serious trouble when the 1st Division brings out their secret weapon, the Iron Spider.
Ibara and the Diversion Team are nervously waiting for the train to arrive when they are attacked yet again by the Ozu Sisters.
Recca has his turn in the ring.

programmes.st: The Call from the Monster, the Warrior from Hell
programmes.d: Domon and Fuko are stuck in Kurei's trap – with the next round just around the corner!
As a new member of Team Hokage, Koganei faces a mighty challenge.

programmes.st: Mokuren Has Returned: The Menace of the Human Tree
programmes.d: Tokiya steps up to rescue a friend.

programmes.st: Tears Shed Because of Girl's Hair!!
programmes.d: Recca faces off against an enemy with a deadly disguise.

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Kate Bliss, Day 5
programmes.d: Kate Bliss and Paul Laidlaw's final trip sees them through Kent. At an incredible auction in Bury St. Edmunds, the Antiques Road Trip record profit is truly smashed, and when the gavel finally goes down one expert is left close to tears.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Christina Trevanion, Day 1
programmes.d: Christina Trevanion and James Braxton are in the Scottish Borders with a '60s Jaguar. James resorts to a flashlight as he rummages in the dark for an occasional table while Christina hopes some silver-plated cutlery will serve up a profit.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Christina Trevanion, Day 2
programmes.d: Christina Trevanion and James Braxton's are in the cold and snowy Trossachs. James investigates some ancient treasures in a Glasgow graveyard and farmer's wife Christina learns why it was the Scots who transformed arable farming.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Christina Trevanion, Day 3
programmes.d: Christina Trevanion and James Braxton start in Levenshulme, Manchester. James has the unusual problem of having too much cash, while Christina struggles with her limited funds, deciding to gamble them on a worn toy train.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Christina Trevanion, Day 4
programmes.d: The seaside town of Southport in Merseyside is Christina Trevanion and James Braxton's next stop. Christina dibs her way to a purchase with a Scouting connection and James spends a vast amount of his cash on two Cantonese jardinières.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Christina Trevanion, Day 5
programmes.d: In Whitley Bay, Christina Trevanion and James Braxton set off on their finale. Christina buys a Chinese silver bowl and James has found six Japanese porcelain teacups. After their buying spree, they head to Ayr for a memorable auction.

programmes.st: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 1
programmes.d: Phil Serrell is joined by new Road Tripper Arusha Irvine on a jaunt around Herefordshire's antique shops in a 1976 Triumph Stag. Phil's joined by Daphne, his dog, while Roo finds a 300-year-old example of Georgian glass.

programmes.st: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 2
programmes.d: Road Trip regular, Phil Serrell, plays a safe bet with a mahogany breakfast table, while Arusha 'Roo' Irvine's all at sea, gambling on an antique pond yacht.

programmes.st: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 3
programmes.d: Roo Irvine and Phil Serrell explore Yorkshire and Derbyshire. Along the way they dig up coal mining musical history, Phil attempts to buy a horse and Roo picks up another piece of her favorite glassware.

programmes.st: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 4
programmes.d: Phil Serrell and Roo Irvine explore Oxfordshire. However, will the Stratford upon Avon auction supply comedy, tragedy or both? Plus, how the Chipping Norton Scouts re-invented British baseball and the Queen of 19th-century science.

programmes.st: Phil Serrell and Arusha Irvine, Day 5
programmes.d: As Roo Irvine and Phil Serrell motor through the Cotswolds, Phil picks up a Victorian marmalade cutter, while Roo hopes a 16th-century bronze thimble will earn her a big profit. But who will be victorious at the final auction in Newent?

programmes.st: David Barby and Margie Cooper, Day 1
programmes.d: Veteran road tripper David Barby joins up with silver expert Margie Cooper for a mammoth journey from Northumberland to Lincolnshire in their classic car. Each expert aims to buy and auction antiques for profit but it's not plane sailing.

programmes.st: David Barby and Margie Cooper, Day 2
programmes.d: It's day two and experts David Barby and Margie Cooper are battling it out in County Durham before winding their way to the auction in Scarborough.

programmes.st: David Barby and Margie Cooper, Day 3
programmes.d: David Barby and Margie Cooper embark on day three of the road trip from Bridlington to Sheffield, and on their way they buy some surprising items.

programmes.st: David Barby and Margie Cooper, Day 4
programmes.d: On the fourth day of their antiques road trip David Barby and Margie Cooper make some brave buys as they head for the auction in Nottingham.

programmes.st: David Barby and Margie Cooper, Day 5
programmes.d: It's the final day for David Barby and Margie Cooper as they battle it out at the last auction in Lincoln.

programmes.st: Anita Manning and Philip Serrel, Day 1
programmes.d: It's a new road trip! Anita Manning and Philip Serrell are touring the north of England in their classic car, aiming for a profit in Edinburgh.
When ladies' man Robin meets the beautiful Jamika at a funeral service, he feels he must have died and gone to heaven.

programmes.t: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead (2024)
programmes.d: Tanya finds her summer plans canceled when her mom jets off for a last-minute retreat, and the elderly babysitter who arrives at her door unexpectedly passes away.
Upon learning of a terminal illness, a shy woman (Queen Latifah) decides to sell off all her possessions and live it up at a posh European hotel.

Jada Pinkett, Queen Latifah, Vivica A. Fox and Kimberly Elise star as four African American women living in a Los Angeles housing project who--pushed to the edge--resort to violence to escape poverty.
Quincy and Monica fall in love as teens and share an all-consuming interest in basketball. Still, they struggle to keep their relationship alive while pursuing success as professional athletes.
Upon learning of a terminal illness, a shy woman (Queen Latifah) decides to sell off all her possessions and live it up at a posh European hotel.
A troubled sailor who embarks on a remarkable journey to confront his past.
An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.
Nicole feels guilty about lying and learns a lesson from a dream. Professional basketball player JULIUS "DR. J" ERVING guest stars as himself.
Mark's stubborn attempts to fix the plumbing fail miserably.
Mark has to go clean his grandfather's cabin, and he and Geneva realize they have different memories of the place. MARK CURRY plays a dual role as Mark and his grandfather.
Geneva and Vanessa move out when Mark treats them poorly, but he soon learns what it feels like.
Mark uses Vanessa's medical shoulder brace to get sympathy from a beautiful woman, but the charade gets out of control.

Webster's friend Rob picks up a tabloid and asks Webster some questions from it. Webster gets the questions right and according to the tabloid, Webster is an alien from Jupiter and he starts to believe it.
Robbers break into the house while Webster is home alone and he has to know how to act.
Katherine is very upset when she finds out that her mother has passed away.
Webster learns that you can be rich without having a lot of money after he gets struck with lottery fever.
When George is assigned to children's sports after a popular segment on Webster's hockey team, he worries his career will be damaged.
It’s Moesha’s 18th birthday, and as a surprise, her family and friends unknowingly invite all of Moesha’s past boyfriends to the party.

programmes.st: I Studied Twelve Years For This?
programmes.d: When Moesha’s car breaks down, she, Hakeem, and Niecy are late for their graduation ceremony.
A frustrated Moesha longs for a promotion from 'gopher' to writer at Vibe magazine but believes that her boss, Joe Scott, would rather she pay her dues with something other than her writing talent.

Eager to get on the fast track at Vibe Magazine, Moesha pretends to be a reporter to land a Maya Angelou interview.  But her ambition, coupled with Maya’s advice, leads Moesha down an entirely different path than she’d planned.
Unable to resist the temptations of college life, Moesha and Niecy become regulars on the party circuit, until their attendance at a late-night frat party takes its toll in more ways than one.
Sandra's show-biz career as a talk-show host threatens the friendship of the whole group when she questions them on the air about sex in the eighties.
Rose receives an offer to buy her building from a real estate magnate whose plan to renovate means tearing down 227.
In charge of the big choir competition, Mary must make room in her have for the visiting choir's deacon, who is notoriously arrogant, thoughtless and pushy.
Alarmed by Brenda and her friends' casual attitude about teen pregnancy, Mary uses some unusual methods to teach them a lesson about parenting that they'll never forget.
Eddie enlists Malcolm to help babysit for his infant cousin.
An argument leads to Malcolm and Eddie recalling their years together.
An old rival's visit causes Simone to pretend she and Malcolm are husband and wife.
An argument over whose room is largest lands Malcolm in the hospital.
Fired from her job and dumped by her girlfriend, Malcolm's sister arrives to stay with him and Eddie.

Fred spots Lena Horne's car in the parking lot while touring the NBC Studios and sneaks away to meet 'the first lady of his dreams.' When there is no answer to the knock on Lena's dressing room door, Fred enters and inspects her personal belongings.

Fred's old flame Juanita brings her daughter Alice to dinner and it's love at first sight for Lamont. Juanita discloses a very delicate and difficult situation when she tells Fred that Alice is really his daughter -- and Lamont is thus dating his sister.
When Fred invites his fiancée Donna and a door-to-door saleslady to dinner on the same evening, Lamont is convulsed by his father's attempts to keep the women apart.

Fred and Lamont find a bum in their yard. The Sanfords are jumping to his every whim for fear he'll make good his threat. The uninvited guest claims Fred pushed him -- creating untold injuries -- and he's threatened to sue them for everything they own.

Faced with more bills than they can pay, Fred and Lamont decide to give a neighborhood party -- and charge admission. Everything goes well until two gangsters show up and make the Sanfords 'an offer they can't refuse.'

Fred thinks Lamont's fascinations with Africa are ludicrous, until he meets Olaiya, a Nigerian woman. Lamont adopts African dress and customs to impress Olaiya, but Lamont's lack of respect for his father interferes with his goal.
George and Louise are caught in the line of fire when Florence's battling parents pay the Jefferson household an unexpected and unnerving visit.
George may be over his head when he introduces his young clerk Marcus to 'roughing it.'
When a superstitious Louise gets a 'sign' that her marriage is doomed, George is forced to make a decision that could change the rest of their lives.
Struggling black comic Lance Barton (Chris Rock) knows what it's like to die on stage. But when his life takes an unexpected turn - straight to heaven - Lance is sure there's been a mistake.
When ladies' man Robin meets the beautiful Jamika at a funeral service, he feels he must have died and gone to heaven.

Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!
Leon loses his radio show because of his X-rated on-air comments. He then gets a letter from a former flame promising him a lifetime of wealth and happiness, and things start looking up!

Advertising executive Marcus Graham is a quintessential bachelor. Graham is never without a new lady on his arm. Enter Jacqueline, his new boss, and Marcus is on the receiving end of his own patented behavior for the first time!
Bobby tries to lure Peter to his boxing promotional team, Carolyn learns of Eli's plan to gentrify the Black Hamptons, and Anthony shares a difficult business decision with Vanessa.
Malcolm and Vanessa throw their post-nuptial summer soiree on the family yacht, but instead of a festive party, it turns into a hotbed of secrets, lies and drama.
Denita receives shocking news from her mystery miracle man, Rbel's personal life descends into chaos, Taj warns Caesar against signing Sasha, and Calvin confronts a dangerous threat.
Rbel confronts Dex about Dani's death, Taj makes a tough choice for his family's future, and Denita uses personal leverage to persuade Caesar to drop his lawsuit against her.
Denita has a change of heart, Rbel gets a break in her gospel career, Taj makes a surprise discovery on his wedding day, and the judge rules in the Caesar Jones v. First Kingdom lawsuit.
In desperate need of her next hit, gospel queen and record executive Denita Jordan reaches a career crossroads when her son Taj endorses a traumatized rising star with a risqué reputation.
Taj goes against the family and brings a reluctant Rbel to meet his mother's rival Caesar at Redeeming Records, spurring a disaster during Denita's lifetime achievement award tribute.
Denita's scheming takes a turn for the worse in the wake of Rbel's Stellar Awards performance, a key piece of evidence is introduced in Dani's murder case, and Taj gets found out.

programmes.st: A Swan Song For Rick And Tasha...
programmes.d: After getting back together, Blue and Keira run into a slight problem when Blue starts to believe that their relationship is contributing to his poor performance.

programmes.st: Miss Me A Little When I'm Gone
programmes.d: Malik gets into a confrontation with his ex-girlfriend's current man, and must choose between her and his current flame. Meanwhile, Blue and Keira have a revealing moment after an argument about how honest their relationship is.

Tasha seeks out counseling from a professional to determine where her datingproblems come from. Eventually Malik stops by, making it a group session with the mother and son duo discovering certain truths about themselves.

Keira and Blue attend the red carpet premiere of Baggers together, but their happiness is short lived when Keira advises Blue to step out during the sex scene. Tasha has an emotional moment with Jason before leaving to reconnect with her father.

Malik is rushed to the hospital after being brutally beaten by Franko. Keiraand Blue have a heart to heart while at the hospital. Jason and Chardonnay reconcile. Tasha has a very heated discussion with her father.
The Game is back! We pick up where season six left off —Malik is no longer able to play, Keira and Blue are still broken up and Jason Pitts is ready to live the retired life.

In part two of the season premiere, Jason confronts the ex-player who provided him with steroids several seasons ago. Keira'sdrunk antics lead to an argument in a bathroom stall as the actress catches Blue with his pants down (literally).
Malik is forced to enter rehab after much denial about his arm problem. Tasha finally visits a doctor and learns she's much further along in her pregnancy than she initially believed.
Justin cooks up a plan to get Mary Jane in the anchor chair, while she and Lee decide whether or not they should have a baby together.
Mary Jane joins forces with Justin, setting forth a plan that could oust Ronda from the anchor chair, but Kara gets caught in the crossfire.
Distrustful of Justin after Kara's firing, Mary Jane tries to make it work with Lee, but resisting Justin is undermining her performance in the coveted co-anchor spot of the morning show.
Since Kara is dealing with her wrongful termination claim, Mary Jane and Justin decide not to admit that they're seeing each other. Mary Jane finds herself in a position of having to lie. (S4, ep12)
Kara discovers Mary Jane is sleeping with Justin, their friendship tailspins and upsets the power dynamic at the studio. Helen sends Niecy to New York.
Mary Janes allows her own housewarming to be transformed into a media event promoting GDU as a big happy family. Niecy returns to Atlanta invigorated, while Patrick becomes a mentor.
Mary Jane and Justin's relationship goes viral. An old family friend of Helen and Paul's, stirs long-forgotten memories of a love triangle that clouded the early years of their marriage.
A prince from Europe comes to New York for a royal holiday dinner and falls in love with the chef that is planning the event.

Stan and Kelly Stevenson seem to be more committed to growing apart rather than growing together. Their friends are caught in the middle of divorce conversations during one of the most joyous seasons of the year.
Two co-workers agree to a loveless marriage of convenience, but as they become acquainted, an unrealized chemistry grows between them.

Local realtor Nia helps an upscale developer find a property for a new resort. Sparks begin to fly between the two during the Christmas season until Nia realizes he has his eyes set on one property that's not for sale... her family's inn.

A heart-broken young woman home for the holidays feels the family pressure to date again. Her sister sets up an online date with her dream man, a pro athlete. But things are not always as they seem, and true love may be closer to home.
To avoid nagging from her family for the holidays, a woman invites her co-worker to pose as her boyfriend.
A successful chef is torn between his current girlfriend and a new flame that sees his potential.
After an on-and-off relationship, Noelle and Terrance reunite during the holidays, but Noelle is surprised when Terrance returns home with a new girlfriend of the same name.
A woman with a downtrodden life who hates Christmas, longs for the life she could have had as a singer. She meets an angel who grants her wish.
Melanie and Derwin expereience trouble in paradise when Melanie takes it upon herself to swab DJ, only to find out the baby isn't Derwin's.
Melanie deals with the backlash of having told Derwin the results of the DNA test, only to learn that the results are incorrect.
When Shawn and Marlon start a children's entertainment business, they meet some tough competition.
Shawn buys the building's newsstand and hires Marlon, with disastrous results.
Shawn finds his perfect woman, but Marlon tries to convince him that she's not what she seems.
Marlon gets discovered by an art patron and creates his own unique paintings.
With Martin and Gina now broken up, Pam sets Gina up with her minister cousin
Martin and Nicole realize that they are both still in love with their former lovers
When Martin (Martin Lawrence) comes down with a cold, he expects Gina (Tisha Campbell) to drop everything to look after him.
Police arrest Martin for credit card fraud, prompting his friends to scramble for bail money.
Pam (Tichina Arnold) turns down a serious offer from Cole (Carl Payne) to go on a wild date with Jerome (Martin Lawrence).

programmes.st: Martin 124: Your Arms Are too Short to Box with Martin
programmes.d: Martin learns about discrimination when he contends with an angry group of little people.
Jamie gets jealous when Fancy's rich ex-boyfriend shows up at the hotel with a diamond ring and a proposal.
Jamie wakes up with a sexy woman--who is marrying someone else that day.
Jamie buys a fancy sports car from a disreputable character and regrets it.
A movie actress friend of Helen's comes on to Jamie while she is in town teaching an acting seminar. Janet Hubert-Whitten guest stars.

Regina's (Wendy Raquel Robinson) new assistant (Terri J. Vaughn) falls in love with Cedric (Cedric the Entertainer); Romeo (Merlin Santana) befriends his formerly overweight neighbor (Ariyan Johnson).
Lovita's (Terri J. Vaughn) frequent visits stress Steve (Steve Harvey); Romeo (Merlin Santana) teaches Aisha (Ariyan Johnson) to dance.
A bully thwarts Romeo's plans for a dance date; Steve's ego is hurt when Regina beats him at Scrabble.
Steve urges Romeo to join the choir despite his lack of musical ability; Cedric helps Bullethead take on the school bully.
Dee wants a baby-- and she wants Shawn as the dad.
To avoid being Grandma's constant companions, the brothers find her a man--but their matchmaking suddenly gets dangerous. Adam West ("Batman" TV series) makes a special appearance.
Marlon is out for revenge when he encounters a Little League rival whom he feels ruined his chances for big-league glory. Kenny Lofton guest stars.
Marlon gets a part in a national musical, ruining Shawn's plans to expand the "Williams Brothers News."
Marlon's ego creates problems between him and his family and friends.  Singer KEITH SWEAT guest stars.
Shawn is forced to confront his feelings towards relationship commitments.  Marlon helps him understand his attitude by reliving a past experience.
Gina and Pam encourage Sheneneh to go on "The Love Jones Connection," a TV dating show.
Gina plans a surprise party for Martin and gets a surprise herself.
Stepping in for the star of a local production, Martin gives a homeboy rendition of the Shakespeare classic "Romeo and Juliet."
Martin and Pam lose their way while hiking in the mountains and must rely on each other to survive.

programmes.st: The Tooth Will Set You Free
programmes.d: Pam goes on a blind date after undergoing hypnosis at the dentist.
After Pam's cousin wins an open mic contest, Martin decides to become her manager.
The hotel staff wants some time apart from each other--then why do they all end up stranded in the same isolated cabin?
Lots of guys have second thoughts about marriage. Three hours before his wedding, Roland is having third, fourth, and fifth thoughts. Good thing he’s got buddies Slim and Mike around to help.

programmes.t: Just Another Girl on the I.R.T
programmes.d: A hip, intelligent Brooklyn teenager dreams of escaping life in the projects to go to college and eventually become a doctor. Things go awry when she meets a cute dude with a Jeep, a brownstone, and a mom who spends a lot of time at her boyfriend's.

Producers T. D. Jakes and Tracey E. Edmonds invite you to the marriage of Sabrina Watson and Jason Taylor, who might be the perfect couple. Unfortunately, their families are a perfect recipe for disaster.
Black Nativity is an inspiring story of faith, family, and forgiveness.
Lots of guys have second thoughts about marriage. Three hours before his wedding, Roland is having third, fourth, and fifth thoughts. Good thing he’s got buddies Slim and Mike around to help.

Before the sun sets, Craig must get his friend out of trouble, find a new job so his parents don't evict him, escape his girlfriend long enough to capture a new woman's heart, and survive a confrontation with the neighborhood menace.

A streetwise man flees South Central Los Angeles, heading to the suburbs to his lottery-winning uncle and cousin to avoid a neighborhood thug with a grudge who has escaped from prison. But trouble soon follows, and the suburbs will never be the same.

Craig and Day-Day have finally moved into their own apartment, but a ghetto grinch breaks in and steals all their Christmas presents—and the rent money. To avoid eviction before Christmas, the cousins take jobs as unarmed security guards at a strip mall.
Jon must go to war with the rowdy regulars of a Southern California dive bar once a popular haven for smokers until forced to comply with the law.
Jon has to convince the foul-mouthed co-owner of the Lucky Leprechaun to change his ways before the bar, also co-owned by his ex-wife, shuts down for good.

programmes.st: Bar Rescue Not Your Godfather's Speakeasy
programmes.d: Jon attempts to save the legendary Las Vegas speakeasy Capo's Restaurant and bring it back to its pre-pandemic glory.
After a near-fatal heart attack, Artie, the owner of Alibi in Las Vegas, lost his zeal for the work, and it's up to Jon to help him get it back.

programmes.st: Grandpa Got Run Over By His Grandkids
programmes.d: Vegas bar Kerry's was meant as a gift from a grandpa to his family, but the grandkids' mismanagement threatens to squander everything.
After a fatal club shooting, Jon must work to rehabilitate the reputation of the Mystique Lounge in West Palm Beach, FL.
The obnoxious behavior of two feuding brothers threatens to put an end to the storied legacy of Royal Oaks, the oldest bar and barbecue joint in Youngstown, Ohio.
The customers call the shots at a rowdy Staten Island bar where they pour their own drinks and cook their own food, so Jon tries to help the owners retake control.

Frank goes toe to toe with an investigative journalist who refuses to give up her source, despite the source admitting to committing murder.
When a suspect voluntarily admits to killing a reality show celebrity chef in his own restaurant, Danny and Baez are convinced the suspect is taking the fall for someone.

Oliver become alarmed that the youth of his beloved town, Hooterville is dwindling so he calls an emergency town meeting to prevent them from leaving. The next thing Oliver knows is that his barn has been volunteered for the new youth center.

Oliver and Lisa discover a root cellar under their house and become trapped when it collapses in on them. Their only hope to get rescued rides on a hilarious game of charades between Arnold the pig and Mr. Drucker.
Victor Brady, a leader in the electronics business, runs up a gambling debt of nearly $250,000 to a Las Vegas casino. Brady's private plane disappears from the radar on its way back to Los Angeles.
Mannix is able to escape from a desert dinner being held by gunmen, only to return with the law and find the couple running it, deny any such incident happened.
Mannix thinks his traffic reporter friend saw something that made his killers shoot down his helicopter.

Betty's cousin Foxey Dolan comes into town and sets her and Betty up for a night out on the town with a man she just met. He also happens to be on the run from crooks he's stolen from, and they'll kill to get their goods back.

Daughter of organized crime leader betrays father by stealing $10m, aide blackmails daughter by exposing treachery to father.

programmes.d: Julie Lofton is a blind woman who witnesses the murder of her neighbor and quickly calls the Sparta police. As the police investigate, they discover the murder was committed to cover up an industrial crime, and now Julie's life may be in danger.

programmes.d: A high school student is the only witness to the brutal rape of his teacher, but his overprotective father refuses to allow him to get involved. He wants to help catch the man that assaulted his teacher, but is he brave enough to disobey his father?

While a deliriously happy Madison helps new love Brett Hayward move in with her, Steve investigates the brutal slaying of palastic surgeon Dr. Yordsberg.
Roger and Lana's marriage is rocky at best. Lana plots for her lover to kill Roger while he is away for the night on business so that she can have all of his money.
An escaped convict embarks on a deadly pursuit to kill every person who was involved in his sentencing. His top target is the kind old judge who the convict intends to return the favor by executing.

A group of Satanic believers starts kidnapping children a week before Halloween so they can sacrifice them on the 31st. When Alex tries to protect a child, she is also taken. The Rangers, Carlos, and Trent track down the group.

While hiking in the Colorado mountains, Alex is kidnapped by a trio of mountain men, who force her to their backwoods cabin. Walker, Trivette, Sandoval, and Malloy follow their trail through the mountains, determined to get her back.

A former member of the IRA brings his daughter to Dallas for medical treatment. However, Irish radicals follow them to Texas to kidnap the girl and force the father to help. The Rangers must find the girl before she dies from her illness.
Richard Kimble knows negligence caused the death of a salvage diver and he jeopardizes his own life when he befriends the girl accused of being a jinx.

The one-armed man hires a gunman to ambush Richard Kimble.

To get some extra cash, Archie has gotten a job driving a taxi. One of his passengers turns out to be Sammy Davis Jr. Sammy inadvertently leaves his briefcase behind and arrangements are made for him to retrieve the briefcase at the Bunker house.

Archie comes home from the laundromat in fury. It seems that he overloaded one of the machines causing the machine to eat his clothes and cause a flood. The irate proprietor of the laundromat, soon stops by to get Archie to pay for the damages.

Gloria is reading over an old love letter that Mike had sent her. This leads to a conversation between Gloria and Edith concerning an old flame of Edith's. Archie hits the roof and demands that Edith not keep any secrets from him.
Edith's cousin, Maude, invites Archie and Edith to the wedding of her daughter, Carol. However, Carol and Maude are not looking forward to Archie, since the man she is marrying happens to be Jewish.

It's Edith and Archie Bunker's 22nd wedding anniversary and their daughter Gloria and her husband Mike are planning a surprise Sunday brunch. Edith is pleasantly surprised, however, Archie's 'no big deal' attitude leads to a huge argument.

Mike writes a letter to President Nixon protesting everything that's wrong with America, including the state of the environment and the nation's involvement in Vietnam. Archie finds out, and he decides he also will write a letter to Tricky Dick.
While moonlighting, driving a taxi for Bert Munson, Archie is in a minor fender bender with a Jewish woman.

Roger, a friend of Mike and Gloria's, stops by. Archie takes one look and labels him as gay even though Mike insists that he isn't. Mike makes a realization that one of Archie's drinking buddies, Steve is a well-adjusted, straight-acting, gay man.

Naomi gets an obscene phone call and doesn't tell the family until the guy calls again. The family unsuccessfully tries to figure out why this guy is after Naomi, blaming her in the process. The family later apologizes.
Ellen has met an attractive, younger man named Glen, but doesn't want Mama to meet him because of the age difference. After the family learns Glen is Ellen's new boyfriend, Mama freaks out.

When the nursing home decides to throw a surprise party for Mama's Aunt Gert, Mama fears that she will end up bored in a nursing home like her. Mama and Aunt Gert ultimately liven up the boring event and everyone has fun.
When a talent contest is announced at the Bigger Jigger, Vint is a big hit and ends up winning, but this starts going to his head.

programmes.st: The Mama Who Came to Dinner
programmes.d: Fran comes up with a way Vint and Naomi can have a dinner party. Mama is against it until Naomi says anything they could have at Mama's would be second-rate.

Mama desperately wants to go to the mall and pick up a hat she really wants, but no one can drive her. The family attempts to teach Mama to drive which is unsuccessful until Mama realizes she may lose out on her hat.

Naomi returns from her self-defense class and shows the family what she learned. Fran and Sonja are impressed with what Naomi does and says and decide to join. After Mama is mugged, she decides to join as well.
When Mama decides to buy her own car from Vint's childhood friend, Willie Potts, she is dismayed that the car is a lemon and demands her money back.

Mama is getting annoyed with Naomi at Food Circus and tells all her customers to go to a different checker. Mr. Palmer, the manager, gets to talking with Mama, who gives him advice, and he ends up offering her a job.

Police solve an old murder case with a painstaking examination of the tool mark on the plastic flex cuff that bound the victim's hands, and a 15-year-old murder case is finally cracked open.
Law enforcement officials fear they may have to release a serial killer from prison until a 24-year-old murder case gives them a chance to lock him up for good.

In early 1984, three-year-old Vanessa Bennett becomes the lone survivor of her family's brutal murder. Initial investigators suspect a serial killer is at large, but decades pass before DNA narrows the suspect pool to one man.

On a bitter morning in 1980, radio intern Helene Pruszynski is found brutalized in a snowy field. After 37 years of fruitless leads, investigators tap into a genealogy website that gives them a lead.

Testimony about the growth of larvae in dead bodies helps convict the man who stabbed a couple to death and strangled their 4-year-old daughter in 1993.

In Missouri, a part-time missionary is convicted, 38 years later, of killing her 5-year-old stepdaughter, and the skeleton of a Michigan boy, dead for 10 years, leads police to a serial killer.

When a deadly house fire claims the life of a family in rural Oklahoma, investigators suspect foul play and it sends a mother on a decades-long crusade to find out what happened to her missing teenage daughter and best friend.

A kidnapper grabs 8-year-old Chad Choice from his home in Texas, then torments his parents with two ransom demands. The case goes cold until the parents receive a chilling package in the mail that contains a letter--and a skull.

Sammy Jo informs Clay of her desire for an annulment to their marriage; Dominique is roughed up by thugs threatening her to cooperate with their boss, as Gary Tilden coincidentally returns to Denver.
Krystle suspects Blake's once passionate feelings for Alexis may still be lingering; Blake and Ben reach a mutual reconciliation; Amanda disappears to London; Leslie Carrington finds Ben.
Clay reluctantly signs the annulment papers to end his and Sammy Jo's marriage; Blake persuades Leslie Carrington to stay in Denver and give Ben a second chance; Adam proposes to Dana.

Krystina lapses into unconsciousness, as doctors fight against time to bring her back; Krystle rebuffs Alexis' sincere concern for Krystina's health; Steven and Sammy Jo assume the appearance of a normal marriage for Danny's sake.
Krystina is flown to California, awaiting a donor for her vital heart transplant; Leslie moves into the Carrington mansion; Blake and Krystle mount a media blitz to plea for a heart donor.
Krystina's only hope for life seems dashed, as the mother of the heart donor retracts her offer to allow the operation; Neil McVane carries out his promise of blackmail.

Krystina is welcomed home, following her so-far successful heart transplant; Alexis' affections are pursued by a wealthy real estate baron; convinced he is not a Carrington, Adam's life begins to crumble.
Adam continues to slip further away from Dana and his family, as doubts to his Carrington heritage have their effect; Alexis ends her relationship with Michael Culhane.

Sarah makes a dress for Krystina identical to one worn by her own little girl; concerned over his irrational behavior, Blake hires a private investigator to follow Adam, as his self-destructive quest leads toward disaster.

Steven struggles with his love for Sammy Jo and his homosexuality; despite being warned of Dirk Maurier's questionable business practices, Alexis agrees to a partnership; Leslie and Clay's romance leads to passion.

Krystle and Blake wait helplessly as the police search for Sarah and Krystina; Adam tips Neal McVane to a stock buyout by Alexis and Dirk Maurier; Nick Kimball celebrates his recent good fortune with a marriage proposal to Dominique.

Krystina and Krystle are reunited, as Sarah is placed under private psychiatric care; Adam confesses his true identity to Blake and Alexis; following a visit to his mother's grave, Adam returns to Dana and pleads for her forgiveness.

Blake is stunned to learn that Clay may be Ben's son; Jackie's attempt to reunite Dominique and Garrett fails; Sarah accepts her baby's death after witnessing the gravesite; Clay tells Leslie of their possible blood ties.

This film follows the ups and downs of Cheng Do as he stumbles his way through his journey to avenge the assassination of his father and brother.

A gifted martial artist protects his adopted village from a villain who wants to build a railroad through the centre of the community.

Newly arrived in Hong Kong, martial arts instructor Ip Man encounters stiff opposition when he begins teaching the Wing Chun fighting style. But instead of bowing to his rivals' demands, he perseveres and retaliates with amazing speed and power.

In this explosive third installment of the blockbuster martial arts series, when a band of brutal gangsters led by crooked property developer (Mike Tyson) make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.

Pete convinces Sam to invite his living wife to the mansion, only to discover she's been keeping a dark secret from him for many years.
