Lisa awakes, saying she's dreamt that she must invest in copper. When Oliver turns that idea down, she seizes on the opportunity to invest in a ten-year-old genius's electric company. Twenty-eight dollars buys her a third of the business.

Arnold, the Ziffels' television-loving pig, has taken on a paper route to save enough money for a new color set. But when bank robbers show up and threaten his dreams, and Lisa and Oliver are held captive in their own home, Arnold has to fight back.

The farmers of Hooterville are headed to France! Or at least they are if they can get organized. As part of an agricultural exchange program, the farmers are offered a chance to join a chartered government flight to Europe.

Lisa (Eva Gabor) is delighted to learn that her Hungarian mother is planning a visit to their little farm. Much to Oliver's (Eddie Albert) disbelief and dismay, a rumor spreads all around Hooterville that Lisa's mother is a European countess.

Love is in the air as the first day of spring arrives in Hooterville. And who better to lead the town in celebrating it than Lisa. She is resolved to show Oliver just what spring is all about and sets out to produce a Spring festival celebration.

It's a hair-raising episode as Eb (Tom Lester) enrolls in a correspondence course to become a barber. Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Eddie Albert) give him the money to learn the trade but learning how to cut hair by mail has its glitches.

For a lawyer, Oliver should be more careful about what he signs. Lisa reminds him that two years ago Oliver made her a promise to take her back to New York for a two-week vacation. And she has it in writing� on the bottom of the kitchen drawer.

It's hard to know who has a curse over Oliver, but he sure has his hands full with Lisa and her fellow Hungarian Lazlo Broslav. Lazlo appears with a letter claiming he once saved the life of Lisa's uncle, and now her family must repay the debt.

There's a problem in Hooterville: no farmer seems able to grow a cash crop on account of the quality of the soil. But as it turns out from Oliver's (Eddie Albert) soil and mineral research, the oft misunderstood rutabaga is an ideal choice.

Green Acres goes Hollywood in this first installment of a two-part season finale. When Arnold the pig appears in a play at the Hooterville Theater, Lisa (Eva Gabor) arranges for an old friend to give Arnold a chance on the big screen.

It's a swine-sational third season finale for Green Acres, as Oliver and Lisa chaperone Arnold, the Ziffel's talented pig, to Hollywood for his big screen test. There's only one problem, Lisa failed to mention that Arnold is not your normal actor.

Hooterville is abuzz as the townsfolk enter a contest sponsored by Peterson's Poi Juice, with a trip to Hawaii as the top prize. But no one expects the winner to be Arnold, the Ziffels' talented pig. Maybe a pig might fly after all, to the islands!

A charity rummage sale asks for donated clothing. Being among the wealthier residents of Hooterville, the organizers look to the Douglases. It isn't long before Oliver has to stop Lisa from giving away his entire wardrobe!

Love is in the air when Eb is quickly engaged to Loreli Appleby, whom he has only known for a day. Eb tries to impress Loreli's father, a farmer, but in typical fashion, he accidentally ruins his future father-in-law's cabbage crop.

When Fire Chief Joe Carson is looking for a way to go to Miami, he hires Oliver as his assistant, hoping Oliver will pay for the trip. The plan backfires, no pun intended, when Oliver starts pointing out what a poor job the chief has been doing.

The highways in Hooterville are in dire need of repair. Oliver is fed up and believes he can make a difference by complaining to his state representative, Ben Hanks. But Hanks' popularity proves greater than his sense of responsibility.

Lisa feels like she should be contributing more and wants to start working in Oliver's construction business. Lisa is like a fish out of water as she arrives to the Monroes' workshop in overalls and causes one problem after another.

Lisa plays bovine matchmaker when Oliver and Lisa decide it is time for their female cow, Eleanor, to start providing milk for the farm. Oliver makes arrangements for Eleanor to mooooove in with the neighbor's bull, but Lisa has other ideas.

The townsfolk look forward to "Old Mail Day", when once a year undelivered mail is handed out. The delayed mail includes a letter all the way from 1917! Oliver is upset by the poor service, but his complaints land with more impact than he intended.

When word spreads that an agricultural student is coming to Hooterville to study with county agent Hank Kimball, no one seems to be interested. However, things change when the folks discover that the student is an attractive blonde.

This episode tells the unusual tale of Hooterville's founding. As the town prepares for its centennial, Oliver announces a reenactment of the town's origins and casts himself and Lisa in the roles of Horace and Doris Hooter.

When a blue feather arrives in the mail for Lisa, her Hungarian roots tell her that trouble is brewing. The feather is a symbol of malfortune to come, and she suspects it was sent by Hungarian gypsies, a warning that they are out to get her.

Don't count chickens before they hatch! Oliver thinks he's laid a gold egg of an idea when he decides to dive beak first into the business of raising chickens. Lisa, on the other hand, sees little difference between raising chickens and children.

All that glitters is not frosted cereal. After a jewelry heist in Chicago, the robbers foolishly stash their booty in the grain bin of a cereal manufacturer. Oliver and Lisa discover the jewels in their bowl of Crickly Wickly!

Oliver Wendell Douglas returns from farm to firm... law firm, that is. When a young and ambitious local graduates from law school, he looks for a potential partner in Hooterville. Oliver is the logical choice. Lisa and Eb help the new venture.

After partnering with a young, local lawyer, Oliver has opened a new law office in Hooterville. However, their secretary, Lisa, shows a lack of necessary skills. Soon, Lisa's job is on the line, even if she is married to one of the partners.

When the Young Peoples Agricultural Society holds their annual convention in Washington, D.C., local members Eb, Mr. Kimball, and Arnold the pig get ready to make the big trip. Oliver and Lisa serve as unintended chaperones.

While Lisa and Oliver consider what to do on their unplanned trip to Washington D.C., Mr. Haney rents their house to a family of eight. Meanwhile in the nation's capital, Lisa and Eb tour the White House, and Mr. Kimball makes official trouble.

When a charmingly sweet doe wanders onto the Douglas farm, an enchanted Lisa befriends the beautiful animal. Having had her heart won over, Lisa resolves to have all deer hunting banned in Hooterville, winning support however necessary.

Farmhand Eb plans to take his girlfriend to a fancy restaurant for her birthday. Only problem is he can't afford it. Oliver encourages Eb to get creative and figure out how to earn the money himself. And if Eb is anything, it's creative.

Lisa becomes enchanted with the diary of a Lydia Plunkett. Found in an old trunk in the barn, the diary from 1898 tells Lydia's life story as a successful businesswoman. Eb and Lisa are glued to every page of the story, but Oliver isn't impressed.

Mr. Haney and Fred Ziffel try to persuade Oliver to invest in a new business venture. "Looney Luke" Needlinger claim to have invented a machine that can turn hay into fresh milk. Oliver is skeptical and tries to prove the machine is a white lie.

Lisa's "Mudder" pays a surprise visit to Lisa and Oliver. Eb good-naturedly introduces her as the Queen of Sicily. As a result, the entire town treats her like royalty. They even go so far as to hold a special day in her honor.

Arnold Ziffel, Hooterville's beloved swine is thought to have rightful claim to a $20,000 fortune. The Birnbacher pork empire has promised that the descendant of the famous weather-predicting pig, Herman, will inherit the vast sum.

Oliver, Lisa and Eb travel to Chicago with Arnold to prove the pig is the rightful heir to the Birnbacher pork empire. Will this pig get rich? Arnold makes a surprising prediction that baffles all, including all the lawyers involved.

When Oliver returns home with Arnold, the citizens in town hold a large reception for Arnold. But when Oliver receives a phone call from a lawyer representing an eccentric relative of the Birnbachers, the riches go into question.

Oliver is mad over the town's dirt road, especially when he finds out that the state set aside money over thirty years ago to fix it. Oliver goes to the Capitol to get the road paved but hits a roadblock when the Ziffels' house must be torn down.

Lisa foretells of a mysterious stranger that will appear into Oliver's life. Enter Tadpole Talbot, Eb's childhood friend who has become a singing sensation. Tadpole has convinced Eb to go out on the road with him and join his band as a roadie.

Oliver become alarmed that the youth of his beloved town, Hooterville is dwindling so he calls an emergency town meeting to prevent them from leaving. The next thing Oliver knows is that his barn has been volunteered for the new youth center.

Oliver is asked to speak at the local high school about his illustrious law career and makes quite an impression on student Kathy Baxter. Oliver must contend with Kathy's fawning as well as her jealous boyfriend is not very happy with Oliver.

Hank Kimball proposes marriage to lady carpenter Ralph Monroe while under the influence of heavy medication. Lisa plans an amazing country wedding only to find out that, Sam, the Justice of the Peace, has forgotten to new his license.

Oliver plants his crops, worrying that they haven't been planted in time for a harvest. Lisa tries to be helpful and mixes up a batch of sour lemonade. Oliver pours out the bitter elixir in the newly planted field, with an unimaginable consequence.

Sam Drucker does not stock any cosmetics in his store, much to the chagrin of Lisa. Lisa decides to set up a "small" display in the store. When the merchandise is delivered, it forces Mr. Drucker to retreat to the front porch.

Mr. Haney discovers an old wish book dating back to 1898 that tells the story of Calvin and Tessie Whittaker who once owned the Douglases' farm and how Calvin traveled to Hollywood to pitch his idea of putting a mouse named Dickey into films.

Oliver and Lisa discover a root cellar under their house and become trapped when it collapses in on them. Their only hope to get rescued rides on a hilarious game of charades between Arnold the pig and Mr. Drucker.

Oliver goes to New York to finish up a case at his old firm. Meanwhile back on the farm, Lisa and Eb find a puppy left on the doorstep. Lisa, in all her innocence, leads Oliver to believe the puppy, affectionally named Freddie, is a human baby.

Oliver has been invited to give a speech at the Bar Association. He is there to advocate for the hiring of ex-convicts. He eventually ends up regretting his speech when he is forced to hire an ex-convict by the name of Willie Dunhill.

Oliver's crops are getting stomped on by Irene the cow. In his frustration, he fires a shotgun to scare Irene away. Instead the blast leads to a hilarious misunderstanding among Lisa, Eb and a life-sized fiberglass cow.

Oliver has become the new School Board President. Unfortunately, Oliver's first day on the job is anything but smooth. Arnold the pig is expelled from his duties as the school's mascot, and Fred Ziffel implores Oliver to defend Arnold.

After receiving a tax refund from the IRS, Oliver inspires his fellow citizens to make similar requests. There's only one problem... those making requests haven't paid their taxes! Nevertheless, the IRS mistakenly sends out half a million dollars!

Oliver is insistent that he and Lisa have a romantic Sunday afternoon picnic, all alone. His romantic gesture for two turns into a picnic for the entire town. Finally, Oliver finds them a romantic refuge in a most unlikely place.

Local boy Dinky Watson has one heck of a story to tell anyone who will listen. When Dinky convinces Lisa to buy a "moon rock" for the considerable sum of $14, Oliver suspects that she is the victim of a practical joke.

When Lisa's Uncle Fedor comes to visit her at the farm, he is visibly upset. He claims that someone is following him. Indeed, Fedor is convinced that the Secret Police are out to steal back a valuable scientific formula, which only he knows.

When Eb places an ad in a magazine claiming to be a wealthy landowner, it catches the eye of a young socialite. When the young woman makes an unexpected visit to Hooterville, Eb is forced to keep up his ruse.

Oliver is upset when he finds out Arnold the pig and he share the same birthday. Jealous that Arnold is getting more attention than he is, Oliver becomes convinced that Lisa is throwing him a surprise party and drives all over town in search for it.

Oliver and Lisa play host to four children from the city, who find themselves in Hooterville as part of a rural exposure program. The kids learn how to milk the cow, pick vegetables, plant seeds, and share sleeping quarters with four-legged friends.

Little Lori Baker, who after coming to stay with the Douglases on a rural experience program, is staying on at the Douglas farm. This city girl, like Oliver, has found that she loves the country life! Lisa decides to throw Lori a welcome party.

Lisa tells a rather fanciful version of how she met and fell in love with Oliver. The Douglases' house guest, little Lori Baker from the city, is all ears. The tale begins with how Lisa's father, the king, was exiled, causing Lisa to flee to Paris.

The residents of Hooterville assume that Oliver Douglas must be broke when Lisa is spotted looking for work and standing in line at the soup kitchen. But assumptions in this town, even logical ones, are bound to be wrong.

There is the old adage that warns never to discuss politics with your spouse... but what if you are both running for the same office?! That predicament comes true when Oliver and Lisa face each other in the Hooterville mayoral election.

Lisa and Oliver try to sort out of the troubles of fools in love. The problems begin when Eb invites both his girlfriend and another young woman to the same dance, while Arnold the pig falls for not one, but two attractive bovines.

Oliver is having a tough time. He has no one to help him pick the apples from his orchard, and he's promised to teach Lisa how to drive. The neighbors are all injured from assisting other harvests, and Lisa has a run-in with a sheriff.

Eb feels the time is right to settle down and marry Darlene. However, he has nowhere near the money it will take to make a down payment on a house. With the help of the Douglases, who have given him two acres of land, Eb applies for a loan.

Eb believes he has found his destiny when an accounting course he has enrolled in turns out to be acting workshop. All the world's a stage. Ed dives into acting and turns every simple interaction at the Douglas farm into a starring role.

After Lisa attends a Women's Liberation League meeting, she gives Oliver a scolding for denying her equal rights and demands to swap chores. While Lisa does a stellar job at Oliver's work, Oliver's attempts at hers leave something to be desired.

Oliver refuses to take Lisa to New York City to attend the wedding anniversary of an old friend. Meanwhile, Eb, always up to something, has a new invisible friend named Charlie. To get her way, Lisa introduces her own invisible friend... Natasha.

Lisa gives the financially-challenged Eb her engagement ring to present to Darlene, his longtime sweetheart, so that he can pop the question. The ring is reportedly valued at $2,000, however, when Darlene's father has it appraised, it's a shocker.

The Douglases are offered a free paint job on their house and barn so long as they allow the paint company free advertising on their barn wall. Meanwhile, Lisa tries to make spaghetti for Oliver's upcoming birthday. Will it prove im-pasta-ble?

Lisa hosts the son of WWII hero Drobny, and all of Hooterville gets excited in anticipation of a surge of tourists. Trouble is, this hero was a duck, as is his son. Oliver tried to warn everyone they were making too much fuss over feathers.

Young lovers Eb and Darlene are just weeks away from their wedding day, but they must choose the marriage venue. It's hard to decide between a church and a car wash. At least it is for Eb, who is still looking for a way to pay for it all.

While staying with the Douglases, Arnold the Pig witnesses a bank robbery when he goes with the Douglases on an errand in Pixley. When Lisa asks him to describe the two robbers, Arnold, reliving the moment, loses his voice from fear.

Lisa worries about Drobny the duck when the water fowl stops eating and sleeping and suffers headaches. Eb suggests the duck needs a duck girlfriend. Lisa agrees and goes about town trying to the right partner for Drobny.

Oliver refuses to take Lisa to the annual Carpenter's Ball because he thinks the attendees are too eccentric for his liking. But Lisa has her own motives to attend. She is trying to get a romance sparked between two local singles.

When Oliver decides to attend night school and enrolls in a farming class, Lisa does the same, taking psychology. Before long, many of the residents of Hooterville are lining up for appointments with the eminent Dr. Lisa.

Aloha! The Douglases vacation in Hawaii. But the daughter of the hotel manager needs to keep secret that she double booked the honeymoon suite. The "sweet" surprise? While Lisa and Oliver settle in, they are unaware that the other room is occupied.

Oliver's heirloom watch is broken so he tries to find his ex-secretary Carol's address to ask her the name of the jeweler who fixed it last time. Carol is now working and living in Los Angeles, and we get a glimpse into her new life.

In this classic series' premiere episode, New York City attorney Oliver Wendell Douglas (Eddie Albert) satisfies his desire for the simple life by buying a farm, much to the chagrin of his wife, Lisa (Eva Gabor). John Charles Daly narrates the tale!

Oliver (Eddie Albert) brings his wife, Lisa (Eva Gabor), to their new home, a ramshackle farm near Hooterville, just outside of Pixley, where she gets to meet the town's oddball residents. Bea Benaderet, Edgar Buchanan and Frank Cady guest star!

Oliver (Eddie Albert) is ready to get farming, but Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts her foot down and says she will leave unless they can hire a decorator to fix the house! Meanwhile, Kate Bradley (Bea Benaderet) teaches Lisa how to make "hotscakes."

When Ramon's bandits storm Danger City for rumored treasure, they slaughter or capture the men, leaving only women and children to face a ruthless "Deguello" if the money isn’t found. Four determined men, already hunting Ramon, join forces to help the town defend itself.

Judy and Alex are the only two survivors of a punitive mission ordered by the rich and ruthless Moran.... The girl becomes his maid and the boy is adopted by a Quaker family. Alex, despite the philosophy of forgiveness he has been taught, plans to take revenge.
A Swedish arms dealer and a Mexican peon team up to rescue the intellectual leader of the Revolutionary cause, while taking part in numerous misadventures along the way.

Con artists Jonathan and Sebastian roam the West seeking easy riches. When magic elixirs and card tricks fail, they target the eccentric Eldorado. Recruiting Ringo Jones and enlisting Eldorado’s niece Juanita, they plot the heist - but with so much at stake, can trust survive among them?
Two outlaws, "The Doctor" and the Indian Girolamo, help a village fight a gang and a corrupt sheriff who has discovered gold beneath the town.

After the Civil War, renegade Rollins and his gang stir conflict between settlers and Native Americans. Apache chief Winnetou and his friend Old Shatterhand try to preserve peace, but Winnetou is framed for the murder of Chief White Buffalo’s son using his own knife. Old Shatterhand must uncover the truth and clear his friend’s name.

After inheriting a land plot in a dusty place called Trinity, the antagonistic half-brothers, Lester and Jesse, reunite to pursue different aspirations, only to find themselves neck-deep in trouble. Will they ever fulfil their dreams?

Billy starts as an innocent outlaw protecting his mother but soon becomes a ruthless killer. When love gives him hope for change, Pat Garrett, a fatherly friend, helps him try to turn his life around. Yet fate drags Billy back into violence, and Garrett is ultimately credited with his death.

programmes.t: You're Jinxed, Friend You've Met Sacramento
programmes.d: This fast-moving tale revolves around the kidnaping of a boxer's daughter. The boxer pays the ransom money but the girl is still not released. Her boyfriend decides to get her back his own way, killing her ruthless captor in a fierce duel.
Mann is a gunman informed by a childhood friend that his father was murdered years earlier by his mother and her lover.

Twelve years ago, Sartana framed his brother Johnny for murder and stole his girlfriend. Now the town's undisputed boss and doted over by his possessive mother, Sartana seems safe - until, his sentence served, Johnny rides back into town.

The construction of the Great Western Railroad causes tension between settlers and Native American tribes. Criminal gang leader Santer seeks control of a gold mine on sacred Apache land and manipulates the railroad route through it. Old Shatterhand, working as a surveyor, uncovers the scheme and tries to warn the Apaches to prevent war.
An avenging outsider riddles a gang of ruthless bandits in revenge for the murder of his family.

When Django’s fiancée is kidnapped by the ruthless Cortez brothers after a bank robbery, he joins forces with an American ally and agent Fulton, who’s tasked with recovering the stolen gold. Together, they face the gang hiding in a remote cave for a perilous rescue and revenge mission.
Just when Cjamango has won a bag of gold in a poker game, he is attacked by the gangs of El Tigre and Don Pablo.

In 1867 Texas, after the Civil War, Colonel Thomas Blake and his men refuse to surrender, raiding Yankee towns. Rumors swirl that Blake kills for pleasure, not the Confederacy, leading to large bounties for his capture. However, Blake seeks $200,000 that vanished during the war from Confederate coffers. He sends Chamaco Gonzales to track down the missing fortune, hidden in General Beauregard's strong box.

programmes.t: Raise Your Hands, Dead Man, You're Under Arrest
programmes.d: The sole survivor, named Sando Kid (Peter Lee Lawrence), of a massacre in the North seeks revenge. After suffering the atrocity, the Kid executes a solo revenge, razes, beats and kills everyone involved in the massacre.
In a Mexican province oppressed by the evil Governor Don Juan de Leyra, the rebel-outlaw Quintana is the sole guardian of justice.

The story of Joaquin Murrieta, a real life Mexican bandit who terrorized California with his gang of raiders and cutthroats during the first half of the 19th century. Some saw him as a murderous outlaw, others as the Mexican Robin Hood.

Ranch owner MacGregor has seven sons and oldest Gregor leads his brothers to Las Mesas, a small town where they want to sell horses. They get into trouble with local people who are related with evil Santillana. After getting imprisoned and losing their horses they decide to go after Santillana's gang.
Western spaghetti set in gold rush times in California, involving circus acrobats, outlaws and a gold mine.
An ex-sheriff sets out to find the bandits who beat and murdered his sister.

A poor Mexican farmer, evicted from his land, turns to banditry and ends up in prison. While he serves his sentence, his young son is adopted by a wealthy family. Once freed, he sets out to reclaim both his child and the $200,000 he hid after a bank robbery, facing a struggle between love and greed.
Ramon avenges his brother's murder and kills the Baxter Family.
Just when Angela and Romeo take a chance at love, Angela's world falls apart when tragedy strikes and shocks all. Dame checks on a troubled Briana who makes a brutal decision no one saw coming.
Romeo drops a bombshell on the Simmons family that rocks Angela to her core! Meanwhile, Egypt's boyfriend Sam does sneaky business at a pawn shop. Panic strikes when a secret engagement is exposed.

Angela and Romeo's rivalry comes to a head and sends shockwaves through Romeo's party. Vanessa's stuck in the middle and JoJo flies off the handle! Meanwhile, a scandal strikes Salt-N-Pepa. Angela is blindsided when Briana does the unexpected.

Romeo blocks everyone on social media and causes uproar, but Angela has receipts! Tee Tee and Tyran join forces to derail Sam and Egypt's trip to the altar, and warn Pepa and Treach before it's too late. Angela plans to squash the beef with Briana.

JoJo seeks marriage guidance from Rev Run when JoJo's baby fever strikes a bad chord with Tanice. Pepa warns Tee Tee to stop meddling in Egypt and Sam's relationship while Briana rages on. Ava breaks down over the legal war with her father Dame.

Angela and Briana's long-lasting feud comes to a head. A secret marriage shocks all. While Romeo is out of the country, Boogie shoots his shot with Angela. Rumor spreads that Tee Tee is in love with Sam and Lil Twist puts it on full blast!

With Romeo on ice, things fire up between Angela and Boogie. Tee Tee runs into some old foes. Sam is served a fair warning before he seeks Pepa and Treach's blessing to marry Egypt. Boogie opens up a rehab facility but Dame smells a scam.

Sam is shook when he asks Treach for his blessing to marry Egypt. Panic strikes when Tee Tee's sabotage derails Sam's proposal. Rev Run counsels JoJo and Tanice while they navigate through their relationship issues before officiating their marriage

Sam's proposal goes off without a hitch and triggers further investigation. Angela bursts into tears when she faces tragedy and heartbreak. Vanessa meets with Master P and is caught back in the middle of a major rivalry between Angela and Romeo.

All hell breaks loose at Egypt's 21st birthday when drama with Sam ignites and Tee Tee tries to shut the cameras down. Security is called when Briana and Eric's wife Aaliyah nearly come to blows. Bow Wow shows up for Angela just when tragedy strikes.

Angela's on the quest for love but the drama with Romeo ignites. Bow Wow arrives in LA to throw JoJo an epic bachelor party. Dame and Boogie clash and the mics come off. Pep's family war rages on when Sam and Tee Tee battle it out.

Bow Wow throws a wild night out for JoJo's bachelor party and things spiral out of control. Angela pops up and Bow sweats it out in the hot seat. Pepa and Dame go head-to-head over unsettled business. Egypt's fiancé Sam plans to reveal a big secret.

All hell breaks loose when Boogie and Ava confront Dame in a brutal family mediation. JoJo's wedding derails when his late nights at the studio push Tanice to her breaking point. Briana meets with an inside source and uncovers dirt on Sam.

Rev Run is blindsided when JoJo gets cold feet just before his wedding. Egypt's engagement party takes a dramatic turn when Romeo and Angela arrive and their feud rages on. Sam takes the stage and exposes a secret that nobody saw coming.

A melee breaks out when Pepa and Treach join forces to protect Egypt. JoJo and his fiancé Tanice battle to the altar, and things take a dramatic turn just before the ceremony. Bow Wow wants to reconnect with Angela and makes his move.

Angela and Romeo's rivalry explodes across headlines. Angela's ex Bow shows up. Tee Tee's rumored love for Sam enrages Pep's sister Maureen to lay down the law and Egypt's caught in the crossfire. The pressure of jail time tests the Dash family.

Egypt's ambushed by her family in Jamaica and the battle lines are drawn! Pep waves her gavel from the sidelines and Tee Tee drops an unexpected bomb. Angela and Bow's new partnership ignites. Boogie struggles to make peace with Dame.
Lil Twist's birthday party explodes into chaos when Briana and Egypt come to blows. Things ignite for Angela and Bow Wow when their romantic past threatens their new business relationship.

Fists fly between Egypt and Briana and the battle lines are drawn! Twist and Sam go head-to-head. Romeo goes ballistic over the drama and enlists Eric to summon everyone to a sit down. Romeo's request enrages the Simmons family.

Romeo's sit-down sparks an uproar throughout the entire cast. Eric's caught in the crossfire and Angela puts Romeo on full blast. After Egypt battles Briana with her fists, she's forced to suffer the wrath of her mother Pepa.

Romeo's sit-down bursts into flames when he enters with Master P and his entourage. The Simmons family strikes back while Boogie stands up for battle. Later, Bow shows up and Romeo is pushed to the brink. Egypt enters the lion's den of Treach's fury.

Romeo quits the show and the cast responds. Treach finds out about Egypt's fist fight with Briana and there is hell to pay. Vanessa's battle with her weight reaches a breaking point when Angela pushes her to model for a swimwear photo shoot.

All hell breaks loose when a brawl explodes between Twist and JoJo. Danger strikes when Angela's stalker sneaks back into the picture and threatens her safety. The Simmons sisters clash over Vanessa's weight loss battle.

JoJo and Twist's fight rages on and bursts into flames. Sam and Egypt threaten Tee Tee's life-changing moment. Angela hits Bow with the burning question about their relationship until Bow spills that he has a secret surprise.

Stevie J and his daughter Savannah and son Stevie Jr. turn up the heat. Pepa's birthday party breaks into chaos. Jojo and Sam nearly come to blows over unresolved beef. A family feud ignites between Tee Tee and Egypt. Jojo and Tanice face heartbreak.

Angela's fast-moving relationship with her new boo raises alarm for Vanessa who has yet to meet him. Pepa comes to Sam's defense and faces off with Twist. Tee Tee stands by her controversial choice to exclude the Peppers from her wedding guest list.

A shocking cheating rumor is exposed. Angela's new boo drops a bomb. Pepa and Tee Tee face off. Stevie J interrogates Savannah on how she's raking in serious cash. Uncle Luke's daughter Cree helps Jojo plan a surprise for Tanice.

Jojo and Tanice's anniversary party goes all the way left when Briana confronts Boogie about being a disloyal friend. Lil Twist and Cree clash. Vanessa presses Angela about meeting her new man. Savannah digs up dirt on Boogie before their first date.

Shocking rumors of infidelity run wild. Boogie's attempt at an intervention for Briana backfires, and the battle lines are drawn. Tee Tee presses Shawn to go to couple's counseling before their trip to the altar.

Angela breaks down in tears when her split with the boxer faces public scrutiny. Cree struggles to reconnect with her father Uncle Luke. Vanessa warns Tee Tee about the rumor spreading behind her back and all hell breaks loose.

Cree and her father Uncle Luke face off in a fiery reunion. The cheating rumor continues to wreak havoc upon Twist's party and Tee Tee's on the warpath. Savannah and Boogie's second uncovers their true feelings for one another.

Tee Tee and Shawn fire up the cheating rumor when their wedding plans derail. Treach checks Egypt and Sam about squashing the beef with Tee Tee and Jojo. Briana's party spirals into chaos when a fight breaks out between Savannah and Eric.

Stevie J puts Savannah in the hot seat for her spending. JoJo and Tanice decide to keep their pregnancy a secret. Tee Tee enlists the help of her mother Maureen to put a stop to the cheating rumor, and there's hell to pay.

After her breakup, Angela plans to bare it all in a sexy swimsuit calendar. Briana and Boogie's friendship comes to an ugly head. Jojo and Sam sit down to squash their beef, but Jojo's upcoming showcase is threatened when tempers flare.

A scandal involving Angela is exposed. The legends Pepa, Uncle Luke and Brat come together at the judge's panel for Jojo's showcase. Egypt's under pressure to perform solo for the first time without Sam. Treach steps in to heal the family.

Jojo's showcase ends in a melee between Tanice and Sakoya, Jojo Hailey's daughter who exposes Angela's past. For the first time in over a year, Egypt and Tee Tee come to a head and settle the score in an epic family reunion.

Treach lays down the law to Egypt when Sam's arrest spirals into danger. Twist breaks the news of a gun charge to Mack Maine. Angela's abrupt move to Atlanta leads to an explosive girl's night. JoJo and Tanice's struggles nearly shut cameras down.

All hell breaks loose at a party when a beef erupts, and fists fly. Twist faces gun charges in court. Cree visits Angela's new home in Atlanta and reveals a heartbreaking secret. Tee Tee and Shawn clash over wedding rings in their rush to the altar.

Pepa warns Sam to be cautious when he breaks the news that he may be facing some serious jail time. Tee Tee's wedding planning rushes on, but will Pepa and Egypt make the guestlist? Uncle Luke advises Cree on squashing the beef with Sakoya.

Stevie J. confronts Savannah about squashing the beef with Tiny's daughter Sakoya. Tyran struggles to reunite Pepa and Tee Tee before the wedding. YDB steps onto the scene when JoJo gets the guys get together for some off-road action.

A surprise bachelor and bachelorette party for Tee Tee and Shawn ends in disaster. Treach supports Egypt's music career while Sam faces serious prison time. Eric and Layzie visit Eazy-E's gravesite, but rumors around his death must be put to rest.

JoJo and Tanice find themselves in a marriage crisis when JoJo's stood up on a group date. Tee Tee and Shawn's wedding plans spiral out of control. Sam seeks guidance from Layzie. Danger strikes for Briana when police come knocking at her door.

Briana's arrest spirals into a traumatic breakdown. Egypt's family crisis leads her to reach out to Tee Tee. Twist is under Young Money pressure when he returns to the stage for a big performance. JoJo and Tanice's marriage struggle gets real.

Between Covid, financial issues, a rainstorm and Pep not being invited, Tee Tee and Shawn's wedding falls apart. JoJo and Tanice are rocked by challenges of married life. Eric confronts Layzie Bone about his involvement in the Eazy-E Documentary.

Tee Tee's wedding day spirals into chaos, but a surprise from Pep shocks all. Meanwhile, Treach warns Sam that a dangerous future lies ahead and enforces protection over Egypt. Jojo plans something special for Tanice to keep the marriage lit.

Tee Tee and Maureen confront Pep about Egypt. Briana's new fling shocks all and brings her face to face with Pep at a family party. JoJo fights to save his marriage with a big surprise for Tanice. Eric spills the tea on his past with Tee Tee.
Angela plans for baby number two and visits a fertility doctor. Tee Tee and Egypt's rivalry comes to an unexpected head. Egypt rushes to marry her fiancé Sam even though Sam faces serious jail time.

Egypt and Sam rush to the little white chapel, but when they drop the bomb on Pep and Treach, Pep objects! Tanice and Sakoya's feud comes to a head. Eazy-E's celebration pushes the group to come together in peace and settle their differences.
Hallmark Original Movie. The Colucci siblings set out to recreate their grandmother's pasta sauce.
Hallmark Original Movie. Haley, finds a renewed Christmas spirit and unexpected love.
Hallmark Original Movie. An ambitious young financier signs up for waltz lessons to impress his fiance.
Hallmark Original Movie. Figure skater Katie brings the royal family together with her Christmas joy.
Hallmark Original Movie. Andy is a passionate artist whose family has been building Rose Parade floats.
Hallmark Original Series. Christmas shop owner Emily Lane investigates a murder at a tree farm.

Las tres reinas: así es como Mikhail Pogodin, director y propietario de una bodega en la ciudad de Chernomorsk, quería nombrar la marca de su nuevo vino, pero no llegó a hacerlo... Fue encontrado muerto en su piso. Viktor, su hijo, regresa a su ciudad natal y decide investigar la causa de la muerte de su padre y salvar el negocio familiar.

Víctor descubre que su padre trabajaba en un vino especial. Mientras tanto, su madrastra Ella es manipulada por su amante para entregar documentos de la bodega. Todo parece indicar un suicidio, pero Víctor no está convencido.

Un experto revela que la nota de despedida de Pogodin es falsa. Víctor busca a un anciano en las montañas para descubrir el secreto del vino "Tres Reinas". Mientras tanto, el vicealcalde ordena vigilarlo de cerca.

Ella intenta sobornar a Víctor para que abandone la investigación. Katya consigue los diarios del padre de Víctor. La prometida de Víctor, Zhenya, llega a la ciudad, pero él se da cuenta de que siempre ha amado a Katya.

programmes.t: Ministry of Evil: The Twisted Cult of Tony Alamo

It was a mystery that plagued law enforcement for over years: four unidentified bodies found inside barrels in the woods; one woman searching for answers from her own troubled past sets herself on a journey to give the victims back their names.

The idyllic life of a French couple (Valérie Donzelli, Jérémie Elkaïm) shatters when they learn that their young son has a brain tumor.
A British intelligence officer turns into a whistleblower after learning about NSA espionage plans designed to ensure passage of a resolution of war against Iraq by the U.N. Security Council in 2003.

In 1977, the young scion of a family real estate empire buys the NFL's San Francisco 49ers; his efforts to build a winner fail until he hires an outcast coach with radical ideas; together they construct a team that begins to challenge NFL royalty.

In 1981, the 49ers complete their miracle Super Bowl run, galvanizing the troubled, iconoclastic city of San Francisco; as the 80s wear on, they celebrate another Super Bowl, welcome new superstar players, and weather drama off the field.

Just as the 49ers appear to reach their peak in the late 1980s, a shocking playoff loss and the burgeoning quarterback controversy between superstar Joe Montana and the up-and-coming Steve Young threaten to tear the team apart.

Written off by the football world, the 1988 49ers come together for another miracle run; Super Bowl XXIII will make or break the team's dynasty, and it might be the last game for the team's brilliant but exhausted head coach, Bill Walsh.

In 1973, the NYPD corners four young African Americans who planned to steal guns for the purpose of self-defense. Visionary police psychologist Harvey Schlossberg convinces his superiors to allow him to negotiate and save the 12 hostages.

Facing 20 years in prison for firing a warning shot, a Florida woman is denied use of a controversial legal defense; learning what went wrong, and who "stand your ground" laws are really designed for.

A young man whose childhood was marked by tragedy learns of a relatively unknown serial killer, and finds himself thinking about unidentified victims; it isn't long before that pursuit becomes a full-time job and identifying victims an obsession.

A young mother is found unresponsive in bed, and her cause of death is determined to be an accidental heroin overdose; but her family questions everything about the circumstances around her death, so they launch their own investigation.

A young man leaves home for the corner store, but dies on a rainy sidewalk just down the street; bystanders claim that he fell off of his bike, but his mom and sister don't buy it; they hit the streets to find answers.

A young girl's life was thrown into chaos when her single mother died by a gunshot wound in their remote mountain home; the journey for the truth would be long and arduous, and it would be thirty years until justice was finally served.

When a college student was found dead in rural Quebec, police refused to call it a murder; but years later, her brother continues his own investigation into her death; on the eve of a trip to return to the scene of the crime, tragedy strikes again.

After meeting online, ex-lovers fight over a vacation package they purchased together that lasted longer than their short relationship.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. In the first proceeding, after a friendship of 20 years, two women begin dating and move-in together; their relationship ends in a fight over a car, appliances and a trip to Cancun. In the next case, a married couple sue for damages after their landlord cuts down a tree on the landlord's property and allegedly damages their child's trampoline.
Neighbors fight over vet bills when a Chihuahua is mauled by a Pit Bull on their shared doorstep. The Pit Bull owner insists the attack never happened.
A woman claims she was only a day late on a payment when her ex-friend repossessed her vehicle; her friend accuses her of filing a false restraining order for harassment.
A man sues a mother and daughter for $7,500 allegedly owed on a car loan agreement; they countersue for harassment and emotional distress.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, a woman accuses the president of a Maltese rescue organization of lying about the pet she adopted. In the next case, a plumber is accused of price-gouging during a natural disaster in Texas that left thousands in need of home repairs. A woman claims she was bullied into paying triple the amount for his services.
Parents of an infant fight over money, visitation and an alleged assault.
A mother sues a California landlord for the 10K court max for allegedly reneging on a deal to rent an apartment to her.
A 12-year-old boy recounts the story of the mauling of his puppy by an unleashed pit bull; the pit-bull owners are sued for the 10K max for vet bills and emotional distress.
An ex-con, trying to get his life back on track, is sued by an ex-girlfriend who claims he damaged her car and reneged on promises to pay back a personal loan.
A woman claims her landlord refused to upgrade her living space in a condemned commercial property.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. In the first case, after a puppy wanders off and goes missing for months, its owner receives a mysterious letter regarding the dog's alleged whereabouts. In the second case, a woman accuses her roommate of moving her boyfriend in without permission and refuses to return her security deposit.
After quitting his job, a driver admits that he was aggravated with his boss and deliberately vandalized one of the vehicles in her fleet.
A man struggles to get his facts straight about the sale of a car when he sues his coworker's wife for payment of the vehicle.

In this episode, Her Honor presides over two cases. In the first, when an English Bulldog has puppies, cousins fight over pick of the litter, alleged breach of a breeding contract and defamation of character. In the next case, after the death of their father, siblings fight over $10K that was allegedly borrowed from his estate and never paid back.
A retired police officer sues a man for failure to pay for his advocacy services in a high-stakes labor dispute involving back wages and allegedly unfair work conditions.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. Up first, when a used car breaks down only days after its purchase, the buyer threatens not to register the vehicle and to accrue hundreds in parking tickets in the seller's name. In the next case, a man buys a car for $600 and then offers to sell it to a friend for 3K; the friend refuses to pay a dime and claims the car was a gift.
A Marine Corps veteran fights with her stepmother over custody of an elderly, rescue dog.
Single parents battle over a failed birthday trip to Vegas, alleged theft and the dismantling of a trampoline.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. In the first, an army vet accuses a car buyer of jumping on her vehicle in an argument over the title; she sues for the court max due to emotional distress. In the next proceeding, a married couple hire a woman to prepare their wills and end up being sued for 8K in damages after allegations of vulgarities and harassment.
A business man takes a risk by opening a new eatery during the height of the pandemic; his venture ends with alleged theft and a contract dispute.
A house flipper and his neighbor claim guns were allegedly drawn during a fight over repairs to their shared driveway.

In this episode, the Judge presides over two cases. In the first, a woman's two puppies are reported stolen while left in the care of a neighbor; she sues for the cost of the dogs and for emotional distress. In the second case, a man sues his ex-fiancé for the 10K court max over vehicle possession; she countersues for thousands she claims she invested in a wedding that never happened.
A woman is accused of 'preemptively' cleaning out a joint bank account she shared with her live-in boyfriend.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, a restraining order and vet bills come into play when custody of a Miniature Australian Shepard is disputed. Next up, brother sues brother over the remaining balance on a motorcycle.

Her Honor rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, a teenager suffers serious head injury after the brakes on his 4-wheeler allegedly give out. Collateral damage from the accident is disputed. In the next case, police are called to the scene when a trained boxer gets into a fight with her estranged girlfriend; they fight over damages as a result of the altercation.
A puppy makes an appearance in court after suffering a broken paw due to alleged negligence. Roommates fight over who's to blame.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman loans her vehicle to a friend to get to work; her friend ends up totaling the car in an accident. Next up, a 30-year friendship comes to an abrupt end when two women fight over a suspended license, the cost of a vehicle and an alleged loan.

The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. First, a man is sued by a friend for the alleged balance owed on a car; he is questioned about an 'evading the police' text that the Judge discovers. Next up, a software engineer sues a friend over design costs for an array of lights to enhance a keytar; the engineer is countersued for harassment.

The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a cat is mauled by a neighbor's leashed dogs after the cat allegedly startles the dogs while on a walk. In the next case, after meeting online, a man loans thousands of dollars to his new girlfriend. She claims he was moving too fast and all monies exchanged were gifts, not loans.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman accuses her ex-boyfriend of selling their car without her permission; they sue each other for emotional distress. In the next proceeding, a woman sues her landlord for the return of money taken under allegedly false pretenses.
A man sues for the 10k court max after being attacked by an off-leash boxer who escaped its dog walker. A neighbor's security camera captures the incident.
An uninsured, unlicensed teenager takes her mother's car and strikes a married couple in the crosswalk. They sue for 10K in medical bills and pain and suffering.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. Up first, a man accuses his ex-girlfriend of using his credit card to bail out her new lover and says she stole his emotional support cat. In the 2nd case, a woman says she cancelled her 35th birthday gala because her dress was not delivered in time; she sues the designer for the cost of the party she never had and for emotional distress.
College football-watching devolves into a costly car collision; former high school friends fight over who is to blame.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first proceeding, a woman passes away on Mother's Day leaving her grieving son scrambling to pay for funeral expenses. In the second case, a woman sues her trainer for a personal loan; he claims her lawsuit was premature.
Half sisters wield a broomstick and a knife in violent disputes against each other; both filed restraining orders and sue for damages.
Ex-business partners fight over their snake-breeding venture; retaliatory theft of a lizard is caught on tape.
A man sues his ex-landlord for a false arrest after a heated argument.

The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a young woman sues her ex-lover for damages over an alleged assault. In the next case, a man's foray into the dog-breeding business ends in a 5K lawsuit over a French Bulldog puppy he sold to his tenant.
A woman sues a photographer for using photos from a bartered session to promote his business on social media.
A mechanic is accused of threatening a customer after a fight over truck repairs escalates.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, after discovering 8K in 'forged' checks, a woman sends a series of angry texts which leads a man to file for a restraining order. In the next case, a woman is evicted days after moving in; she sues for return of rent and emotional distress.
Newlyweds sue their wedding planner for the 10k court max alleging their wedding party was ejected from a wedding venue; the planner says they still owe her money.
A struggling mother of three claims her brother and his girlfriend disposed of her possessions without her permission.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a woman asks a friend to buy and install a washer/dryer in her home but refuses to pay him despite her continued use of the appliances. She claims the color wasn't right and that they were damaged. In the second case, when a woman purchases a used car from a friend, she leaves hundreds of toll charges in her wake.
A farm worker must defend against his ex-boss's claims that he owes for a phone, rent and a personal loan.
Ex-roommates fight over a violent assault involving a lockout and an emotional support dog; one man claims he blacked out after a chokehold, another says it was self defense.
After providing a home for her grandchildren while her son was in prison, a woman's relationship with her family falls apart after he and his fiance move in.
A woman is granted a lifetime restraining order against an ex-boyfriend who sues her for thousands in personal belongings he says she never returned.
Brothers clash over funeral expenses for their mother; accusations of defamation ensue.
An American Bully breeder sues a man for the remaining balance on a puppy purchased for his seven-year-old daughter.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first proceeding, an unlicensed, uninsured teenager driver fails to yield and crashes into a vehicle carrying a mother and her toddler; who is at fault? In the next case, two men sue each other for the court maximum after their car-trade agreement falls apart; the fate of a 1947 classic Chrysler Sedan hangs in the balance.

After an apartment fire made her homeless, a woman sues a former friend who offered her a place to stay, for a wrongful eviction and unwanted sexual advances while staying with him. He countersues for damages due to false accusations.
After a fight with his pregnant girlfriend, a man invites a female acquaintance to move in; they clash over a personal loan, car damages and assault.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, two Pit Bulls jump over a fence and maul a neighbor's small dog; the Judge speaks to the responsibility that comes with owning dangerous dog breeds. In the next case, a woman sues a hairstylist claiming money owed for improperly installing a wig and destroying it.
A firearms instructor seeks compensation for a valuable rifle he loaned to an ailing client; the defendant says he sold the weapon after the client passed away to satisfy a debt owed by the deceased.

A fundraising effort via t-shirt sales goes awry when a woman is dissatisfied with sample shirts and asks for a refund from a small business owner; a heated incident and a 5k defamation countersuit follow soon after.
A dog attack on Christmas day divides neighbors who fight over which of their dogs was the aggressor and who is responsible for vet bills.

In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a man drives 2,000 miles to come to the aid of his son and his son's teen fiancé, then is sued by the couple for alleged theft and unpaid wages. In the next case, a newlywed is sued by her sister-in-law for a trip and for wedding expenses.
While away on vacation in Hawaii, a woman claims her roommate turned in a lease renewal without her permission; the roommate has another story.
Both parties sue for the 10k court max when parents fight with their child over ownership of an 18-wheeler; the Judge throws out the countersuit after a heated exchange.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a couple reunites after 30 years only to be torn apart over personal loans after an ex-girlfriend comes back into the picture. In the second case, both parties sue for the 10k court maximum when the cost of a Wolfdog and alleged loss of income are disputed.
Relative strangers regret signing a lease together when one loses their job and the other decides not to move in.
The owner of a wig business claims that a stylist has been making purchases in someone else's name.

The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. Up first, after a failed attempt to live together and dueling 10K lawsuits, the only thing two sisters agree on is that their relationship is forever damaged. In the second case, a woman sues a close friend for damages to her car he allegedly caused by attempting to temporarily repair the vehicle for her.
After being evicted by her father, a teenager sues him for the return of property she says is worth thousands. He accuses her of smoking pot and of breaking promises to help out around the house.
A man is evicted from his own apartment after a roommate files a restraining order against him; they fight over Covid relief, unpaid rent and alleged fraud.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a man says he is hired by a former high school teammate to make auto-parts deliveries. Their working relationship ends with a claim of unpaid wages. In the second case, a mother of three claims she gave her children's uncle $2700 to buy a truck that never arrived; he claims he delivered the truck to her front door.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first proceeding, a young man decides that his new luxury car needs a clear, protective wrap; his girlfriend provides money for the purchase. She is demanding payback. In the next case, after a lengthy incarceration, a man sues relatives for the return of treasured keepsakes from their family home.
A woman claims a bathroom leak caused extensive water damage after a plumber made a house call; the owner of the plumbing company denies any wrongdoing.
A chihuahua is mauled by a larger dog; neighbors fight over liability and vet bills.
Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.
A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.
A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.
When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.
A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy

Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!
When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

Cuando un importante comprador de jade no queda impresionado con la lente Pozo 3, Claudia se ve obligada a tomar una decisión difícil.
La carrera para preparar el campamento en Wolverine se convierte en una pesadilla.
El brutal viaje a una nueva mina separa a la familia y lleva a Josh al límite.
Claudia está ansiosa por comenzar a construir el nuevo sitio.
Los pequeños lujos en el campamento animan a un equipo descontento y los visitantes sorpresa aumentan las esperanzas de Claudia.
Gary y Josh no regresan de una búsqueda rutinaria de combustible y los núcleos de perforación ponen en duda la calidad de las lentes de jade en 2 Mile.
La tripulación finalmente logra un gran éxito, pero con el invierno acercándose, a Claudia le preocupa que el gran hallazgo haya llegado demasiado tarde.
Claudia está desesperada por comenzar a minar, pero las brutales condiciones del camino la hacen preguntarse si la tripulación logrará llegar a su reclamo.
Mientras Guy y Gary se apresuran a arreglar el camino destrozado hacia el reclamo, Claudia espera que un nuevo miembro de la tripulación sea el billete de la suerte.
La juerga de compras sorpresa de Robin estresa a Claudia cuando sus errores de compra retrasan la temporada minera.
Claudia intenta mantener la paz cuando Robin y su padre chocan, mientras el equipo lucha por solucionar un problema tras otro en su camión minero.
Gary y Josh están frustrados por una serie de crisis, mientras Claudia hace un anuncio impactante que descarrila los planes de Robin y provoca un conflicto entre la pareja.
Tensions boil over between Robin, Josh and Steve about how to mine and when Claudia steps in, things get downright explosive.
Plagados de problemas con los camiones, Robin y su equipo corren para hacer un suministro de combustible antes de que el equipo se agote.
Robin choca con Claudia y Josh por la calidad del jade que sale de su pozo, mientras que el intento de Larry de ayudar a llevar el barracón de la tripulación al campamento fracasa.
Claudia y su equipo están decididos a seguir minando a pesar de los incendios forestales que arden alrededor de su reclamo, hasta que las cosas empeoran y tienen que correr para salir.
Después de perder dos semanas de minería en los incendios forestales, Claudia y Robin corren el riesgo de regresar a Two Mile y apostar por la apertura de un nuevo pozo.
Claudia se estresa tratando de preparar su mejor jade para los compradores, mientras la moral de su equipo se pone a prueba mientras luchan contra el frío.
Claudia hace todo lo posible para intentar hacer una gran venta a los compradores de jade, mientras en la mina Guy y Gary luchan contra la primera tormenta de nieve de la temporada.
Claudia presiona a su equipo para que siga minando a pesar de las gélidas temperaturas y el deterioro de las condiciones de las carreteras.
La temporada de Claudia comienza con fuerza cuando recibe un pedido de jade por valor de 250 000 dólares.
Después de años de obtener la parte dura del trato con Scrappy Larry, Robin le hace una broma a su viejo amigo.
Bajo presión para cumplir con el ajustado plazo de su comprador, Robin y Josh chocan cuando se topan con interminables problemas.
Cuando una avería grave amenaza con cerrar la mina, Claudia y Robin toman la arriesgada decisión.
Josh evita por poco el desastre al entrar a la mina con una carga de combustible y Claudia queda devastada.
Claudia y Robin se apresuran a encontrar una segunda roca de jade antes de que su comprador abandone el trato.
Claudia recurre a su padre Steve en busca de ayuda cuando teme que la mayor venta de su carrera minera se le esté escapando de las manos.
La tensión surge entre Claudia, Robin y Josh mientras hacen un último intento por cerrar un trato con un comprador de Vietnam.
Mover una enorme losa de jade pone a prueba el antiguo equipo de la mina y la paciencia de Josh.
Arrastrar una roca de 20 toneladas por el peligroso camino para salir de la mina resulta demasiado para su viejo camión 6-Pack.
Robin descubre una enorme lente de jade en Two Mile, pero podría ser demasiado grande para que su pequeña operación la excave.
Cuando una extraña tormenta de nieve en agosto deja a Claudia y Robin varados en Two Mile, Gary y Garon intentan salvar el día conduciendo a través de la tormenta.
Robin toma una decisión difícil sobre su querido camión minero 6-Pack después de otra costosa avería.
Con el invierno acercándose, Claudia lleva a su exhausto equipo al límite, provocando que los ánimos se caldeen.
La nueva temporada minera está llena de sorpresas desagradables, pero un rescate improbable salva el día.
Harto de trabajar para su padre, Josh inicia su propio negocio de transporte por carretera con un semirremolque nuevo.
El camión del ejército muere en el brutal camino hacia la mina.

A hastily married couple quickly devolve into a life of affairs, meddling parents, and therapy.

Frank (Joel Murray) has had enough of the downward spiral of American culture. Divorced, recently fired, and possibly terminally ill, Frank feels he has nothing left to live for.
Veteran actor Andy Garcia steps into the director's chair for his first voyage into feature filmmaking with this heartfelt tribute to revolutionary, late-'50s-era Cuba featuring Dustin Hoffman.
A musician couple captures a sound not meant for human ears. Soon, a stranger knocks on their door and their reality begins to blur.
The very day he’s about to drive his family to a new life in the city, geologist Kristian Elkjord senses something wrong with the mountain that overlooks his scenic town.

Ana joins an army of girls engaged in a never-ending war. Ana trains as a sharpshooter and discovers newfound freedom and courage. Though she finds strength, she comes to realize that she’s not the killer they want her to be.
Four young siblings vow to stay together when their mother dies. But when a ghostly presence torments them and a lawyer threatens their pact, the four must stand together or be torn apart forever.
Determined to honor his father's scouting legacy an Assistant Scoutmaster convinces a group of kids to secretly ditch a slumber party in favor of a weekend scout trip.
Recently divorced, newly rich, and utterly miserable, Danny [Kevin Corrigan] would seem to be the perfect test subject for a definitive look at the relationship between money and happiness.
A newlywed couple's idyllic country-lake honeymoon descends into chaos.

Alice (Emily Beecham) has engineered a special flower that makes its owner happy. Against company policy, Alice takes one home to her son. As their plant grows, so does Alice's suspicion that her new creation may not be as harmless as they thought.
Stream critically acclaimed independent films, powerful documentaries, and world cinema with Magnolia Selects.
Kat Connors' (Shailene Woodley) glamorous but strange mother Eve vanishes. Kat is excited by her new freedom but disturbing facts surface and the mystery begins to haunt her.
Golden Globe® Winner for best foreign language film. Katja’s family is killed in a terrorist attack and her life falls apart. The killers are set free and Katja can do nothing else but seek justice.

When a young mother and true believer from a violent IRA family is captured by British spies, she is forced to betray everything she believes in for the sake of her son in this taut, high-stakes thriller.
The story of New Zealander Burt Munro, who spent years building a 1920 Indian motorcycle -- a bike which helped him set the land-speed world record at Utah's Bonneville Salt Flats in 1967.
It's Christmas Eve in Tinseltown and Sin-Dee (newcomer Kitana Kiki Rodriguez) is back on the block.
A love story and murder mystery inspired by the true story of the infamous missing persons case in New York.
Camille's life as a lonely suburban teenager changes when she befriends a group of girl skateboarders.

Kate struggles to deal with the consequences of her actions. Alex returns to find much has changed.

Stevie's daughter is coming to stay for a month, and it's the first time they've seen each other in two years.
Rose secretly begins seeing Leo, unaware of his history with Stevie.
After Rose and Stevie enthusiastically prepare dinner for Rose's "mystery man," the girls are horrified.
Jodi has introduced Boer goats onto Drovers and wants to associate them with Gungellan Fresh.
When Alex returns from the city with Fiona, Stevie fears he's changed his mind about leaving his wife.
Jodi wakes from a nightmare about fleeing from the hitman with Rob. Stevie wakes alone and full of remorse.
After being offered a two-year research job in Africa, Dave tries to pretend he isn't interested.
After learning of Dave's plan to move to Africa, Kate realises she still has feelings for him.
It's shearing time at Drovers Run and Jodi is happy until her conflicted feelings for Rob recently returned.
Kate's romantic exit has stirred up some confusing emotions for Jodi.
Jodi is spooked by a mysterious vision and develops an angry rash on her wrists and ankles.
Alex and Marcus come to blows over the future of Killarney, and Marcus reveals a secret.
Jodi questions her sanity when she is haunted by visions of her ancestor Emma McLeod and a murdered convict.
Jodi has her hands full with a major decision when both Riley and Matt declare their love for her.
For Jodi and Matt, love is blossoming, and the world is looking remarkably sunny.
Kate has a hard time coming to grips with her best friend's death.
When Regan's sister Grace inherits part of Drovers Run from Jodi, Regan tries to reconcile with her.
Alex's plan to propose to Stevie goes horribly wrong.
When sheep rustlers steal Drovers' breeding stock, Grace and Stevie take the law into their own hands.
Stevie is not looking forward to being nothing more than "Mrs. Alex Ryan".
The girls fight to stop Drovers Run becoming the site of a toxic waste dump.
Grace kidnaps a government official to prevent the toxic dump from going ahead.
Rose arrives at Drovers Run accompanied by Stevie's mother, Helen.
On Alex and Stevie's wedding day, things will run smoothly if the groom is able to get out of jail in time.
While clashing with a rich new neighbour, Heath Barrett, Grace becomes convinced she's cursed Drovers Run.
Grace's world is turned upside down when she's forced to admit there's something wrong with her beloved horse.
Grace may be making a deal with the devil when she accepts a secret loan from Ashleigh.
Stevie returns from her honeymoon and plans to spend the summer with Rose before she starts university.
Rose returns from the hospital in a wheelchair and is involved in a freak car crash.
The girls are investigating a mysterious explosion at the fuel dump.
Stevie's loyalty to Drovers Run is tested when she moves into Killarney.
The women of Drovers Run team up with the men from Killarney to hunt a dangerous beast.
Blinded by love, Kate decides to go on the run with her outlaw boyfriend Mitch.
Grace faces an uphill battle to save Ashleigh's life when they are left stranded in the bush.
There are preparations for a Medieval Fair organised for drought relief.
Grace takes drastic action to capture a cattle thief, and the girls uncover Ashleigh's secret plan.
It's Halloween and odd things occur on Drovers Run.
The arrival of a mysterious stranger forces Grace to reconsider her future with Heath.
Marcus suspects Heath is cheating on Grace, but jealousy might be clouding his judgement.
It's Christmas Eve, and Alex makes a surprise return from Argentina to visit Stevie.
The car accident has thrown everyone off balance. Kate is obsessed with proving Riley survived.
