Lose yourself in the flickering shadows of distortion. A hypnotic sequence of sonic violence and dark imagery designed to unsettle the soul. Bow to the heavy. Welcome to the Manic Ritual.

Pure, unadulterated speed and fury! Experience blistering shred solos, aggressive riffing, and neck-snapping rhythms. Turn up the volume and brace yourself for an unstoppable wave of high-octane thrash metal chaos!

Step into the headquarters for everything that shakes the earth. From the pillars of the classics to the pioneers of the new era, this is where the heart of metal beats loudest. This is where you belong.

Found your new baseline. Rock Bottom digs deep into the rawest hard rock and alt-anthems. We’re hitting the floor with heavy riffs and soulful grit—no shovels required, just volume. This is the foundation of everything that kicks.

A tribute to the global brotherhood that refuses to fit in. This collection celebrates the unity that turns fans into a tribe. In this pit, no one stands alone—together, we are the loudest force on earth.

Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

Ein legendärer Auftritt einer Hardrock-Legende in Hamburg! Diese Aufnahme vereint frisches Material mit zeitlosen Klassikern. Eine musikalische Reise durch mehr als dreißig Jahre Rockgeschichte, die pure Energie und Nostalgie verspricht.
A bump on the head has bored housewife (Rosanna Arquette) believing she is the mysterious Susan (Madonna).
Jack and Caroline are a happy couple... until a layoff makes him a house husband and her a working wife!
A widowed nurse (Lucille Ball) and her EIGHT kids get together with a widower (Henry Fonda) and his TEN kids!
Jack Lemmon and Shirley MacLaine are delightful in this tale of love and ambition.
In this madcap farce, two Chicago musicians disguise themselves as women to avoid the mob.
Burt Lancaster and Tony Curtis star in this classic as a ruthless journalist and an unscrupulous press agent.
Two convicts on the run are bound together by an unbreakable chain and separated by unbridled hatred.
Ram and Eddie are two jazz musicians living in Paris and falling in love with two young American girls.

programmes.t: In The Heat Of The Night
programmes.d: Sidney Poitier and Rod Steiger shine in this classic mystery-thriller that took home five Academy Awards®.
Jodie Foster makes her directorial debut and stars in this drama about a single mother and her son.
The kids at Western Summit High have "issues," and newcomer Charlie Bartlett is coming to their rescue.
Four pals party all night in a hot tub and wake up--in 1986--and must survive the 80s...again.
The hot tub time machine is fired up again for more side-splitting adventures, this time in the future!
A woman embarks on a journey through LA in hopes of making it to her last party before the world ends.
A young woman wants the wedding day, despite the fact that the groomsmen have decided to rob a bank.
Two con men bet on who can bilk $50,000 from a wealthy woman in this dirty, rotten comedy!
Martin Short stars as a ten-year-old who plans revenge on his uncle (Charles Grodin).
Weird Al Yankovic plays a daydreamer who becomes the manager of a TV station that's losing ratings and money.
Our righteous heroes Bill and Ted discover their destiny in a time-travelling phone booth! Excellent!
The titular time travelers become history when they wind up face to face with the Grim Reaper!
In this classic comedy, a teenager's life is improved when his werewolf nature bursts through!

Only young Andy realizes that his doll, Chucky, is inhabited by the soul of a killer and is responsible for a spate of gruesome murders. But the real terror begins when Chucky becomes determined to transfer his evil spirit to a human being... Andy!

Kevin Costner and Gene Hackman star in this taut, political thriller that sees Costner, as Naval Commander Tom Farrell, on the hunt for a very real killer and a very unreal Russian mole, and all the clues lead back to himself. Sean Young co-stars.

Gene Hackman and Tommy Lee Jones headline this explosive action-thriller about Green Beret (Hackman) who uncovers a terrifying military conspiracy when he is tasked with escorting a U.S. soldier (Jones) back to the States for a court martial.

When an explosion jolts Boston, bomb squad expert Jimmy Dove (Jeff Bridges) is thrust into the most harrowing work of his career. And when evidence points to his former mentor (Tommy Lee Jones), Dove must face a bitter enemy and a haunting past.
Billy Crystal and Gregory Hines have winning chemistry as two of the Windy City's finest (and wildest) cops, out to nail Chicago's toughest criminal.
A drug called "Fatal Beauty" has hit the streets of Los Angeles, and tough cop Rita Rizzoli is out to take down the drug lord responsible!
A one-woman vigilante force is out for revenge against those who hooked her sister on drugs.
Foxy Brown (Pam Grier) vows vengeance against those responsible for the death of an undercover officer.
Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) grows up to become the reigning head of Harlem's black mafia.
Recovering from an onslaught of bullets that would have killed a lesser man, the Godfather of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs, is back and is out for revenge.
Action legends return to the genre that made them famous in this big, brassy and action-packed tale!
Tupac Shakur and James Belushi are two corrupt police detectives caught in a dangerous web of deceit in this gritty, smart and tough action thriller.

As members of the Los Angeles Police Department's elite anti-gang unit, a seasoned cop (Robert Duvall) and his new partner (Sean Penn) are called in to assist with the crackdown against the mounting gang violence in the slums of East Los Angeles.
Three problem teens headed to jail...until a police captain offers them a deal to work for him and go undercover in the hip L.A. club scene.

They were misfits... and heroes! William Holden stars as Lt. Col. Robert T. Frederick who takes on the daunting task of melding a renegade group of American and Canadian recruits into a crack team of commando warriors in this riveting WWII saga.
The legendary Clark Gable and Burt Lancaster star in this gripping, classic military drama aboard a submarine.

Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

Enraged when a biker gang kills his fiancée (Cheryl Ladd), a Green Beret (Tony Young) declares war and discovers that revenge is a dish best served...with a rocket launcher! Also stars William Smith, Marvin Gaye, Peter Brown and Michael Sterns.

When a vicious motorcycle gang launches an assault on a small town and a local girl (Elizabeth James), Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) goes on a one-man crusade to save the town and the girl! The first of the wildly successful Billy Jack feature films.

When the leader of the Glory Stompers is brutally attacked by a psychotic rival biker gang that kidnaps his girl and leaves him for dead, he gathers a few buddies and sets out to settle the score! Starring Dennis Hopper, Jody McCrea and Casey Kasem.
When a biker gang cyclist is injured and hospitalized, he is kidnapped from the hospital but dies. A funeral is staged in the local church with a drunken, drugged-out orgy.
In this terrifying sequel, the spirits of the dead are still hell-bent on luring the Freeling's daughter to the other side, where lies only evil!
Nancy Allen, Tom Skerritt, Zelda Rubenstein and Heather O'Rourke star in this suspense-filled conclusion to the terrifying "Poltergeist" trilogy.
The streets of London are transformed into a smorgasbord for an alien creature with a taste for human flesh. Don't just panic…run for your lives!

John Saxon, Dennis Hopper and the legendary Basil Rathbone star in this atmospheric -- and influential -- sci-fi cult classic as a team of astronauts embark upon a rescue mission to Mars only to encounter a seductive alien, The Queen of Blood!

When a rocket lands on Mars, the crew finds the planet not entirely dead. As the team begins to explore, they are attacked by horrific and demented creatures at every turn. Battling for their lives, can the survivors make it back to their ship?
The legendary Mario Bava directs this cult-classic tale of extra-terrestrial terror when an alien race targets a crew of unsuspecting astronauts.
One of the great horror anthology films, and director Mario Bava's personal favorite of his works, "Black Sabbath" tells three short tales of horror.
Horror, suspense, and the occult mix to make this a hair-raising experience even for veteran horror fans.
Christopher Lee plays the Lord Chief Justice of 17th century England who condemns women as witches to further his political and sexual needs.

Under the guise of a witch-hunt, the notorious "witch hunter" Matthew Hopkins and his henchmen ravage and plunder a lawless England. Innocent men and women are tortured and put to death for being witches...but one man is determined to stop them.

programmes.t: The Fall Of The House Of Usher (1960)
programmes.d: For the Ushers, their house is more than just a home...it’s their tomb…as Vincent Price goes to ghastly lengths to end his family's bloodline forever.
Happily-ever-after goes under the knife in this horror classic, a saga of murder, madness and forbidden desire.
In this ghoulish tale, Ray Milland stars as a painter whose obsessive fear of being buried alive compels him to build himself a tomb with a view!
Three short stories based on the works of Edgar Allan Poe, with Vincent Price in the starring roles and directed by the great Roger Corman.
Scream legends Vincent Price, Peter Lorre and Boris Karloff are three rival sorcerers whose paths cross when one is turned into a raven by another!
A century after a warlock was burned alive, his descendant (Vincent Price) inherits the family estate and the horrors of the past return to haunt him.

programmes.t: The Masque Of The Red Death (1964)
programmes.d: Death and debauchery reign in the castle of Price Prospero (Vincent Price)...and when it reigns it pours...in this lavish Edgar Allan Poe adaptation.
Vincent Price's deceased first wife, Ligeia, casts a long shadow over his ill-advised second marriage, especially when Ligeia’s spirit returns.
When a soldier encounters a haunting woman on a desolate beach, his hunt for her leads to a dark, foreboding castle and its mysterious owner.

Discover the true meaning of survival of the fittest as a terrifying creature from the past brings the future to its knees in this Danish-American kaiju creature feature about a cold-blooded 90-foot killer whose time has come... again!

In South Korea's first entry into the kaiju genre, a monstrous creature creates destruction throughout Korea as scientists race against time to create a refrigerant that may be the only weapon to stop the monster before it destroys the country!

It's the horrifying and hilarious ride into the darkest regions of hell that started it all! When Jonathan (Peter Liapis) inherits his late father's home and finds a book of spells, he unlocks unimaginable demonic horrors!

The Ghoulies are back and more devilish than ever as they turn an unsuspecting carnival into a house of pandemonium in this wildly outrageous sequel to the smash hit "Ghoulies!" Damon Martin and Royal Dano star in this cult-classic!
On a quiet, tree-lined street, evil has arrived through an old television set when killer zombies crawl out of a horror film and into suburbia!
When a nightclub entrepreneur gets taken out by the mob, his girlfriend calls upon a voodoo high priest to carry out an unholy plan for revenge.

John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.
John Wayne teams with William Holden and director John Ford for this rousing tale of one of the most daring cavalry exploits in all of history.

In this hilarious western spoof, insurance broker Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) unwittingly sells a life insurance policy worth $100,000 to the infamous Jesse James. Now, he has to figure out how to keep the deadliest outlaw in history alive!

Welcome to America's Wild - and very wacky - West! Burt Reynolds, Clint Walker, Ossie Davis and Angie Dickinson star in this tongue-in-cheek tale of love, lust and larceny as an amiable con-artist is hire by a sexy widow to break into the U.S. Mint.

Stacy Keach, Haris Yulin and Faye Dunaway give riveting performances in this controversial and myth-shattering reexamination of the darker side of gunslinger Doc Holliday and the actions that led to the infamous showdown in Tombstone, Arizona.

Jesse James and his gang ride again! David , Keith and Robert Carradine; James and Stacy Keach; Randy and Dennis Quaid; Christopher and Nicholas Guest depict real-life siblings in this charged portrayal of the Old West's legendary bandits.

In their only screen pairing, legends Marlon Brando and Jack Nicholson set the screen ablaze as a bounty hunter and his horse-thieving prey in director Arthur Penn's intense and startlingly realistic western classic! Harry Dean Stanton co-stars.

To cattle baron Brandt Ruger (Gene Hackman), his stunning wife (Candice Bergen) is just one of his possessions. So when a notorious bandit kidnaps her, an enraged Ruger organizes a posse to recover his property dead or alive in the searing western!

Lee Van Cleef and  John Phillip Law star in this bona fide Spaghetti Western classic as, fifteen years after bandits massacred his family, a young man seeking revenge forms an unlikely alliance with the outlaw who was framed for the murders.

Get ready for fast-paced, explosive action as Lee Van Cleef stars as Sabata, the mysterious, steely-eyed gunslinger who, after he discovers the masterminds behind an elaborate bank heist, imposes his bullet-laced brand of justice on a guilty town.

Under the brutal rule of garrison leader Col. Skimmel, a group of Mexican revolutionaries hire gunslinger Sabata (Yul Brynner) to rob a transport of gold in order to buy weapons. But the Colonel has other plans...taking the gold for himself.

The great Lee Van Cleef ("Death Rides a Horse") returns as the famous freewheeling gunslinger Sabata. In this third and final go-round for the enigmatic sharpshooter, Sabata seeks revenge when a band of desperadoes bilks him out of $5,000.

East Meets West in this charming spaghetti western in which three petty crooks try to transform an East Coast dandy into a real Wild West man! Starring Terrence Hill, Gregory Walcott, Harry Carey Jr. and Dominic Barto and directed by Enzo Barboni!

A man recently released from a five-year prison sentence seeks vengeance against the former friend who has violated his trust and sought his death. Starring Thomas Hunter, Henry Silva, and Dan Duryea.

James Garner stars in this rollicking western spoof that has him taking on the job of a frontier town sheriff who must fend off villains (led by Walter Brennen) from every direction...all without breaking a sweat or dirtying his shiny black boots!

James Garner is back in the saddle again as hustler Latigo Smith whose latest con is passing off cowhand Jug (Jack Elam) as the dreaded gunman Swifty Morgan. But when the real Swifty shows up, the Wild West is going to get a whole lot wackier!

Frontier scout Jess Remsberg leads a wagon train through hostile territory to Fort Conchos. But underneath his valor, he has an ulterior motive: to settle a score with the man he believes killed his wife. James Garner and Sidney Poitier star.

Sharpshooter Matthew Quigley (Tom Selleck) thinks he's been hired to kill wild dogs in Australia. But a wealthy cattle baron (Alan Rickman) has far more nefarious plans for the sharpshooter. Laura San Giacomo also stars in this stylish western.

A go-between (Kelly Lynch) helps California marijuana growers (Billy Bob Thornton, Hank Azaria) take action when their boss is killed.
A small-town sheriff (Nick Nolte) becomes unhinged, thanks in part to his abusive, alcoholic father (James Coburn).
An unhappy car dealer (Bruce Willis) believes that a dime-store author/philosopher (Albert Finney) has the answers to life's important questions.
A kickboxer must prevent the launch of a nuclear missile by terrorists targeting New York.
A harried director must contend with technical foul-ups and actors' shenanigans on the set of a low-budget film.
An Irish hustler (Robert Arkins) puts together a Dublin band that covers hits of 1960s American soul.
On their way to a boxing match, four young men take a wrong turn in Chicago and find danger as witnesses to murder.
A lumberjack helps a tribe of rain-forest elves protect their kingdom from an evil spirit and greedy clear-cutters.
A bank robber (Steve McQueen) and his wife (Ali MacGraw) cross a big shot (Ben Johnson) and are chased to the Mexican border.
A 1920s playboy returns from a stint in the French Foreign Legion to reclaim his lover, a mobster's mistress.
Self-destructiveness and disdain for the middle class mark the life of artist Jean-Michel Basquiat, dead of an overdose in 1988.

An Irish hustler (Robert Arkins) puts together a Dublin band that covers hits of 1960s American soul.

An insecure young woman (Marissa Ribisi) and her promiscuous best friend (Juliette Lewis) seek relationships.
A shy teenage outcast (Hugh O'Conor) uses his chemistry genius to poison his family and others in '60s England.

A young woman flees New York City after being implicated in a murder and moves to Los Angeles, where she rents a room from a writer. They begin an affair, but it seems she's been followed by a homicidal duplicate of herself.
Circumstances transform a mild-mannered accountant (Johnny Depp) into a notorious Old West gunslinger.
Dr. John Kellogg (Anthony Hopkins) treats a young couple (Bridget Fonda, Matthew Broderick) for their imagined ailments at his Michigan sanitorium circa 1907.

A scientist uses an intellectually disabled gardener as a guinea pig in his experiments with intelligence enhancing drugs and virtual reality. The man transforms into a genius, but not without side effects.
An insurance executive (Linda Fiorentino) skips town with drug money and stops at nothing to get what she wants.

Gladys y César descubren inconsistencias en sus casas prefabricadas en Medellín y Chinauta. Alba recibe amenazas tras desistir del contrato. Rocio y Sebastián investigan con cámara oculta. Constructora Ksas y Dinami Casa enfrentan denuncias por incumplimientos y estafas. Las víctimas luchan por justicia.
Un amor pasajero entre Flaminio Báez y María del Tránsito Veloza resulta en el nacimiento de un hijo con problemas médicos y una batalla de por vida.

Desde 2023 Colombia vive una ola de violencia en sus carreteras. Trágicos asesinatos y los crecientes asaltos y homicidios en el transporte intermunicipal, la inseguridad en las vías es un reflejo de la indiferencia gubernamental.

Desde su inicio en 1996, Séptimo Día ha sido un referente del periodismo investigativo en Colombia. Historias arriesgadas, denuncias impactantes y la valentía de sus reporteros han marcado el rumbo de una televisión que no teme confrontar la verdad.

En 2014, en Santana, Huila, Jorge Cangrejo fue secuestrado y baleado en la cabeza por sus captores, quienes lo enterraron creyéndolo muerto. Milagrosamente sobrevivió y se convirtió en aliado clave de las autoridades para identificar a los responsables. Dos victimarios permanecen detenidos, acusados de tentativa de homicidio, porte ilegal de armas y secuestro simple agravado, enfrentando hasta 40 años de prisión.

En una vereda de Cimitarra, Santander, Pedro Suta se obsesiona con Irene, esposa de su jefe Arcilio. Tras ser rechazado, la asesina junto a su hijo menor, decapitándola y desmembrando al niño. Ese día, Arcilio estaba de viaje con otro hijo por un tratamiento médico. Al descubrirse las desapariciones, la comunidad se alerta e inicia una intensa búsqueda para dar con el responsable del doble homicidio.
Ana Rosa García, venezolana de 24 años, fue hallada muerta el 7 de julio de 2020 en Inírida. Su ex, Alexander Matiz, obsesionado con ella, fue identificado por registros telefónicos y capturado.

En 2014, en Bogotá, Valentina Maldonado, de 15 años, murió al estallar una granada lanzada contra su vivienda mientras dormía junto a su madre. La investigación reveló que el objetivo real era su madre, considerada un obstáculo por Marcos Andrés Roldán, quien tenía una obsesión con la adolescente. Cinco personas fueron condenadas entre 14 y 20 años de prisión por homicidio.
Una niña indígena es asesinada cerca de la Sierra Nevada. Se investiga y descubren la implicación de su primo y Nefer Niño, este último contratado por celos. La investigación revela más tras 7 meses.
El asesinato del niño Luis Santiago en Chía (Cundinamarca).
El 23 de junio de 2014 en Chinchiná, Alfair Sabogal atacó brutalmente a seis miembros de una familia por celos e intentó matar a su pareja, Diana Marín, quien quedó con secuelas visuales.

Damien demanda a Sal por 35 millones de dólares, alegando que el servicio de transporte de Sal arruinó su matrimonio al dejar a su esposa en la casa de su amante. Sal niega la culpa y prioriza el crecimiento empresarial.
Mario está demandando a la psíquica del vecindario, Lydia, por $30,000 y la imposición negligente de angustia emocional después de prometer eliminar su maldición ... por una tarifa.
Alexa está demandando a su novio de un año y medio por cancelar abruptamente el viaje de su vida porque necesitaba traer a su hijo de 7 años.

Michelle está demandando a Michael y Nuri por negligencia y pérdida comercial después de que su spa de alta gama se dañó cuando los lechones de Michael y Nuri fueron liberados y se volvieron locos en su negocio.
Miguel está demandando a su ex novia, Jasmine, por la totalidad de los $5 millones que ella ganó a través de un boleto instantáneo que compró con su tarjeta de crédito.

La redención de Orlando narra su lucha de 22 años con la drogadicción, su paso por la policía durante el cartel de Medellín, y su vuelta a la vida como ejemplo tras rehabilitarse y recomponerse con su familia.

En 2020, Ximena y José, estudiantes en México, fueron asesinados tras un carnaval. Un sombrero azul ligado al crimen llevó a la captura de una criminal. Sus familias buscan justicia mientras el juicio fue retrasado por la pandemia.

Hace dos años, Chelsea admitió que engañaba en secreto a su novio Corey con su amigo, pero él la perdonó. ¿Necesita saber quién es el padre de su bebé? ¡Entonces, Liz y Bailey se han unido gracias a Josh como padre de sus hijos!
Estas parejas decidieron hacer un trío que terminó en un embarazo. Ahora que los bebés han nacido, estos hombres niegan ser los padres. Hoy se verán obligados a reconocer la verdad.

Maury está celebrando las fiestas contando cuentos junto a la chimenea. Compartirá las historias de los antiguos invitados que vinieron a hacerse pruebas de paternidad, al detector de mentiras y más. ¡Averigua si estos invitados han sido buenos o malos!

Un niño pequeño sufrió lesiones graves que pusieron en peligro su vida, pero no solo su madre, Jessica, es considerada sospechosa, sino que su novio, Major, y su abuela, Crystal, también están siendo investigados. ¡Descubre la impactante verdad hoy!
La adolescente Megan vive con su antiguo novio controlador Rick. Megan no puede ir a la escuela, buscar trabajo, ni comer sin su permiso. ¿Pueden su tía y Steve lograr hacerla entender?
Josh quiere recuperar a su ex, pero sus engaños resurgen; Deja confronta a su novio por su propuesta indecente a dos strippers gemelas; Misti se entera de que su novio la está engañando nuevamente.

Tres mejores amigos acuerdan tener un trío; la prometida de Leo confronta a su primo por unas fotos explícitas que le envió; Brian quiere dejar a su posesiva novia, pero ella se niega a rendirse sin luchar.

Greg le contará a su novia, Deidra, que trabaja en secreto como prostituto gay. El novio de Madrina sigue siendo infiel a ella con su ex. Después, Ro-Ro tiene dos novias y hoy la obligarán a elegir a una de ellas.

Scotty dice que siente que su novia tiene un GPS en él las 24 horas del día, los 7 días de la semana; Giovanni culpa a su novia por su infidelidad; Winona quiere condimentar las cosas en el dormitorio.

Las cosas iban muy bien con su nueva novia hasta que Roger se encontró en la cama con su amiga; el novio de Kandy revela un secreto que podría cambiar su generosidad; el novio de Dannisha continúa rogando por un trío.

Accidentes eléctricos en Colombia han dejado víctimas con secuelas graves. Jóvenes como Carol y Samir luchan por justicia contra empresas de energía, mientras la falta de medidas de seguridad pone en evidencia graves fallos en la infraestructura.
Dos bebés intercambiados al nacer son criados por familias diferentes, lo que lleva a una disputa legal.

Varias tragedias ocurren en instituciones educativas debido a negligencias. La caída de una antena, un ascensor defectuoso y un cielorraso sin anclajes adecuados causaron muertes y heridas, exponiendo serias falencias en la seguridad.

En el Valle del Cauca, Luis Emiro Acosta Pérez estafó a cientos de personas prometiendo viviendas. En Bogotá, César Augusto Pinzón cobró por impugnar comparendos y desapareció. Tramitadores de visas engañaron a personas prometiendo citas rápidas en la embajada americana. Las víctimas buscan justicia.
El uso de aplicaciones de citas va en aumento, y mientras unos encuentran el amor, otros caen en la violencia.

Usuarios de buses intermunicipales que sufrieron accidentes de tránsito denuncian que las empresas no les respondieron. Casos en Tolima, Cundinamarca y Bolívar muestran negligencia y falta de responsabilidad. Las víctimas buscan justicia y compensación por los daños sufridos.

Luisa Fernanda Garcés, de 13 años, desapareció en Villamaría, Caldas, en agosto de 2014, un día después de que su familia denunciara un abuso sexual sufrido meses antes. Su cuerpo fue hallado en el río Cauca. Gabriel Jaime Marulanda, el agresor identificado, fue capturado en 2015 y condenado a 46 años por homicidio agravado y 9 años más por actos sexuales con menor de edad.

En 2009, desaparece Lía Patricia Nasser, estudiante de derecho de 26 años en Barranquilla. Entre los sospechosos: un compañero de colegio, su novio y la exnovia de su esposo. Tras descartar la hipótesis inicial, la investigación llevó a la captura de Eduardo Osa, compañero universitario, cuya culpabilidad quedó demostrada. La necropsia reveló asfixia mecánica. Osa aceptó los cargos y fue condenado a 26 años por homicidio y ocultamiento de pruebas.

María Inés, de 21 años, soñaba con ser ingeniera de minas. Empezó una relación con Yobany, casado y mayor. En 2011, embarazada de 4 meses, fue hallada asesinada en su casa. La policía sospecha de un crimen pasional y revisa cámaras para hallar pistas

Heily García, de 23 años y madre de cuatro hijos, fue asesinada en Cali en 2017. Su amiga Mayra Alejandra Ramírez, tras perder a su propio bebé, fingió estar embarazada y asesinó a Heily para quedarse con su recién nacida, Luciana, a quien luego abandonó. La bebé fue hallada con vida días después. Mayra se entregó meses después y fue condenada a 20 años de prisión.

Ángela Carolina fue hallada muerta en Villa Rica, Tolima. John Fredy, movido por odio hacia su esposa infiel, confesó el crimen y fue condenado a 36 años por el asesinato de Carolina y su esposa. Luego intentó cambiar su versión, sin éxito.

El Rastro cumple 10 años revelando crímenes reales, mentes criminales e impactantes investigaciones. A través de 117 episodios, el programa ha marcado la TV colombiana con historias estremecedoras y casos que retan la imaginación.

En 2012, en Cúcuta, Johana Rincón fue hallada muerta en su casa con señales de tortura. Aunque su esposo fue el primer sospechoso, la investigación reveló que el verdadero culpable era su sobrino, quien la asesinó para robar los ahorros de su tío. Tras huir a Venezuela y esconderse durante varios días, fue capturado por la Policía al regresar a Colombia.
Giselle está demandando a su padre, Albert Martinez, por angustia emocional y $145,000 por el costo de cancelar su boda.

Michael Brown demanda a Víctor Hernández, propietario de la tienda de tatuajes "Savage Skin", por 50.000 dólares, alegando que Víctor alteró maliciosamente el diseño de su tatuaje debido a un rencor por salir con la ex de Víctor, provocando un tatuaje vergonzoso. Víctor dice que es un malentendido.
Gabriella está demandando a su ex empleadora, Jaqueline Mendoza, por $600,000 por angustia mental y despido injustificado luego de sufrir un ataque de pánico durante una celebración de la empresa.

Daneidy Barrera, "Epa Colombia," relata cómo en 2019 atacó estaciones de Transmilenio durante los paros, arrepintiéndose y entregándose a las autoridades. Desde niña ayudaba a sus padres vendiendo ropa, y tras superar una adicción a las drogas, se volvió viral apoyando a la Selección Colombia. Hoy es empresaria exitosa con más de 500 empleados en su negocio de keratinas, aunque su fama la mantiene bajo escrutinio judicial.
En Bocas de Satinga, hombres armados talan árboles finos en 3 días. La madera se transporta ilegalmente por río, un comercio tan rentable como el narcotráfico y difícil de controlar.

Colombia registró la víctima 12.000 de minas antipersonal, ubicándose como el segundo país más afectado tras Afganistán. En los Montes de María, 172 hombres del Batallón Humanitario de Desminado de la Infantería de Marina arriesgan sus vidas escarbando la tierra centímetro a centímetro para desactivar minas. El teniente Juan Carlos narra esta peligrosa labor diaria contra un enemigo invisible.

Amanda le contó a su mejor amiga Dorella que se acostó con su prometido Joey. ¡Ahora Amanda afirma que Joey podría ser el padre de su hijo! Luego, Tommy dice que no es el padre del bebé de Kim y ¿es Deshawn el padre del bebé de Tifanny?
Kiki y su hermana Sad-e aseguran que el novio de Kiki, Tavon, es un infiel. ¿Qué dirán cuando aparezca en nuestra cámara oculta? Entonces, ¿los hijos de James y Nikkie son realmente suyos?

Los invitados del episodio de hoy de MAURY tienen secretos que revelar, pero ¿se arrepentirán de contarlos? Hay relaciones en peligro. Puede que haya corazones rotos. ¿Podrán estas parejas sobrevivir a los secretos que amenazan con separarlos? Entérate en el episodio de MAURY de hoy.
¿Marlo tocó a su hija con Sandra cuando ella tenía 7 años? Ha evitado confrontarla durante casi 10 años, pero hoy, Sandra no se irá hasta que no se sepa la verdad y se haga justicia por su hija.

Una joven muchacha y agraciada físicamente, huérfana de padre y madre, se crio con su abuelo de oficio ruletero el cual al morir le deja como única herencia el "taxi" por lo que la joven se tiene que meter a trabajar de ruletera y de esa forma comienza a correr una serie de aventuras y situaciones, acompañada casi siempre de su ángel guardián que es su novio de oficio policía

El voragine de una vida artistica turbulenta, una sensual bailarina tuvo tres hijos naturales, pero los niÃ±os crecen y ansiosos exigen conocer a su padre. tres bellas voces, tres sentimientos heridos cantando reclamaron el por que de ser bastardos.

Manuel es honesto líder del gremio de pescadores camaroneros que se enfrenta a los dueños de las embarcaciones y se enamora de Olivia, hija de Álvaro, uno de sus contrarios. Él impulsa la creación de una cooperativa de trabajadores, pero Álvaro y sus socios le proponen financiar la compra de un barco para él a cambio de que olvide la cooperativa, pues no les conviene la competencia.
El dolor de una mujer provocará que Doña Tormenta tome venganza de quienes trataron de herirla en el pasado.

A robot representing the Netherlands fights with the Brits in this heat. After attempting to attack one of the house robots, Growler makes an example of one of the competitors. Matilda uses her flywheel in spectacular fashion.

One hapless robot gets expertly dismantled by another competitor, leaving Refbot to count them out. Maybe the house robots should take notes. A Hail Mary charge leaves yet another robot out of the arena.
The Seventh Wars continues, eight more robots with high hopes of becoming champion enter the arena. One robot has to see a man about a dog, as Mr. Psycho and Growler team up on a competitor.
Only one team can win the £20,000 cash prize, and they could be competing in this week’s heat. A close first round leaves it up to the judges to decide who will progress through the heat.
A newcomer has an aggressive start to their first battle, with no competitor or house robot left unchallenged. Will they make it all the way to final or be punished for their hubris?

The first heat of the second Revival Series begins. Robots return from previous series to take on the daring newcomers and each other. Competitors get bullied and thrown around the ring as they desperately try to scrape a place in the finals.
A tentative start to the second heat ends in carnage as the house robots and competitors go all out to qualify. Shunt delivers the final blow for one contestant.

The third heat shows devastating weapons put into action, being on the receiving end of these could mean elimination for an unlucky competitor. The house robots take on cleaning duties as they remove immobilised robots from the arena floor.
One competitor draws first blood only seconds into the first round. After suffering severe damage at the hands of another competitor, one robots chance at the finals may be lost.
The last chance for combatants to fight for a place in the Grand Final. With the newcomers outnumbering the veterans, will the first timers make up for their lack of experience?

This episode, a new Robot Wars champion will emerge! Sparks and scraps are sure to fly in this explosive series finale. Winners will have to make it through the four-way melees and head-to-head battles to be able to prove themselves in the final.
Four teams comprised of celebrities and veteran roboteers. Which celebrity has a natural flare for mechanical combat and who will be having words with their agent when they end up in the pit?
Four more stars team up with professionals to test their battle ability. Will it lead them to fame and fortune, or will they end up being thrown to the curb along with the other scraps?

Initially released on VHS and broadcast on TV a year later, the World Championship featured sixteen robots from eleven different countries. A straight knockout competition would decide which robot would be known as the World Champion.

From the producers of Robot Wars, Rescue Robots is a robot inspired, challenge based gameshow. Teams of children pilot their chosen robots and attempt to overcome pre-set obstacles, prevent imminent disasters and save Calamity City.
Transporter, Ranger and Talon face a potential nuclear disaster. Will the team prevent meltdown, or will this challenge prove too explosive for them?
The water pressure’s rising and if the team don’t get there soon the whole of Calamity City will be underwater. Will the team sink or swim?
A series of major fires have broken out on the outskirts of Calamity City. Will the team extinguish the inferno before it blows it destroys all in its path?
A satellite with vital scientific data has crash landed in the desert. Will the team be able to retrieve it safely, or will the information be lost forever?

Newcomers, veterans and a recent President enter the fray in this first Heat of the series. Competitors are eliminated left, right and centre and only the strongest will survive to compete in the finals.
A veteran only heat features the current reigning Champions, Carbide. Will Carbide’s streak be brought to an end by the other robots, more experienced and eager than ever?
Even the judges aren’t safe as two robots collide, sending shrapnel through the bullet-resistant shields around the arena. Two very different styles of robot meet in the finals.

One newcomer stares down seven veterans, will their induction into the arena be successful, or will their inexperience find them in the pit? One robot will have a second chance to qualify in the Redemption Round.

The final heat features only veterans, here for an opportunity to make up for their mistakes in the previous tournaments. Only one competitor will make it into the Grand Finals, and the others must suffer defeat, again.
After lengthy repairs and inspirational pep talks, the qualifiers prepare to fight for the title. A 10-way Robot Rumble will give the victor a spot in the Grand Finals, alongside the heat winners.

Robot fightings newest competition begins! In the first heat, meet new robots and some familiar faces as teams get a feel for the arena and size up their competition. Filmed in Grantham in front of a live audience, robots battle for survival in the Robots Live Arena.

Heat 2 of the UKs most brutal robot combat competition takes the action to Crawley in the south of England. Winners and losers from Heat 1 face fresh opponents, fighting to secure a win and guarantee their place in the finals.

Its the last chance for teams to secure a spot before the final. In savage and tactical 1v1 matches, teams battle for a place in the top 16. New robots join the fray, hoping for a last-minute victory to advance to the championship.

The most battle-hardened combat robots in the UK compete in the MechMania Grand Final. After three grueling heats, only the toughest survive. The tournament is now a single-elimination, 1v1, sudden-death formatuntil one team emerges as the victorious champion.
The first of sixteen Heats in the seventh series. The four-way melees kick off the competition with true carnage. Sir Killalot may have changed the tide of battle during the finals.
The second round of heats sees eight new robots join the fight for The Seventh Wars title. Growler is de-muzzled as he rampages through the arena in the four-way melees, no-one is safe.
After the four-way melees, the house robots do not hesitate to get involved with the remaining competitors. A counter-attack leads to one of the shortest finals robot wars has ever seen.
An equal number of newcomers and veterans take to the battlefield in this episode, experience versus vigor in today’s heats. The innocent Refbot gets attacked after cease is called.

Hoon lets Gae Ttong stay at the house again, and subtle feelings grow between them. Gae Ttong promises to leave if she fails to persuade Scholar Lee. Meanwhile, Soo orders an investigation into the Crown Prince's murder.

Hoon is taken to the palace and discovers that Soo is now the king. Soo asks him to protect Gae Ttong. Meanwhile, Gae Ttong volunteers to pose as a noble lady to help Flower Crew with Scholar Lee's marriage.
Hoon is flustered by Gae Ttong's unexpected kiss, but she remembers nothing the next morning. Meanwhile, Scholar Lee asks her to deliver his napchae documents to his bride's home, but she refuses.
The Rogue dies mysteriously in prison, leaving Hoon with the words "Fox Guard." Hoon and Joon search for the killer. Meanwhile, Gae Ttong reunites with her brother Kang, raising Ji Hwa's suspicions.
Soo finally reunites with Gae Ttong and promises to marry her. However, Hoon realizes he has feelings for her. Meanwhile, his investigation into the Rogue's death leads him closer to the truth.

Realizing Gae Ttong is in danger because of his father, Hoon agrees to arrange her marriage to Soo. Meanwhile, Flower Crew begins the difficult task of transforming Gae Ttong into a proper noble lady.

Gae Ttong continues her training to become a noble lady. Joon helps Lady Yim and realizes his memories of his mother were wrong. Meanwhile, the Chief State Councillor discovers that Soo has been deceiving him.
Gae Ttong suddenly confesses her love to Hoon. While Hoon tries to avoid her, Soo grows anxious after overhearing them. He meets Lady Kang and asks Lord Kang to speed up the royal wedding.
Hoon and Gae Ttong confess their love, but a marriage ban is declared until after the royal wedding. Meanwhile, Lord Kang investigates Flower Crew and discovers Young Soo's true identity.

Hoon tells Soo that his marriage to Gae Ttong is canceled. Lady Kang forces Gae Ttong into the queen selection process using her secret against her. At the palace, Gae Ttong finally learns Soo's true identity.

Furious over Soo and Hoon's deception, Gae Ttong refuses to remain a noble lady. But Moon Seok warns that many lives depend on her becoming queen. After a beautiful day with Hoon, she prepares to say goodbye.
Gae Ttong enters the second queen selection, but an astrologist claims she has the fortune of the dead. Soo discovers a political scheme, while Kang and Young Soo are taken in for interrogation.
The Chief and Second State Councillors plot treason. Gae Ttong is kidnapped to force Hoon's cooperation, while Young Soo is imprisoned. Joon uses all his resources to find where they are being held.
Flower Crew, Joseon's top matchmaking agency, consists of Ma Hoon, Young Soo, and Do Joon. While working on a case, they meet Gae Ttong. Soon after, blacksmith Kim Soo asks Flower Crew for help.
Flower Crew agrees to arrange Gae Ttong and Soo's wedding. Everything goes smoothly until Soo suddenly disappears. Gae Ttong and Hoon set out to find him, but their search seems hopeless.

Walt meets his match during a heated negotiation with actor Mike Colter ("Luke Cage"); a "legendary" video game becomes both Walt's trash and Ming's treasure.
Troma Entertainment co-founder Lloyd Kaufman and his crew put the guys through a grueling audition to see if they have what it takes to be in a Troma film.
The boys take a field trip to the Pez Museum to determine if Walt is actually the owner of an extremely rare and valuable piece of Pez history.
When Walt learns that Ming befriended actor Michael Gray ("Shazam!"), he decides that he must meet the "Mighty Mortal."
Kevin and the boys attend the grand opening of Funko's new headquarters, where they get honored with their very own Pop! figures.
Walt challenges the staff to a flea market sales competition.
Kevin rallies the Stash for a game of street hockey; hurricane Mewes blows through the Stash, and no one is safe.
Walt wants the Stash to shoot its first commercial and to have Bryan direct it; one customer brings in a fanboy's dream.
Walt reluctantly lets Ming run a new sales promotion for the Stash based around zombies, but Ming's scary idea might be too frightening for Walt.
Walt and the guys take a road trip to an unexpected convention; the guys find a treasure in the trash; a customer brings in an item Mike wants for himself.
Ming dares Walt, Bryan and Mike to get tattoos; one customer looks for romance while another makes a deal.
Walt and the guys throw a birthday party at the Stash; larger-than-life Darth Vader helmet.
The guys attend a local auction; bad results from mixing comic books and cigars.
The guys pursue the Jersey Devil; selling Thundercat figures.
When Walt and Mike fall ill, Ming must run Stash by himself; first issues of Iron Man and Daredevil.
Ming arranges for the Stash to join in on the local sidewalk sale; Walt sells some early "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles" comics.
Mike and Ming participate in a 5K zombie run for Kevin's charity; Walt buys an unusual item.
Kevin visits the Stash for a book signing; Jay acts as security; a customer brings in original artwork.
The guys prepare for a visit from Stan Lee; Walt has a chance to buy a valuable comic book.
The Stash sells an independent comic book, so the guys can see a costumed MMA fight; Walt buys nostalgic underwear.
The guys want to make a sandwich that represents the Stash; a valuable comic.
Walt negotiates for an original Asteroids arcade cabinet; Ming is excited for GI Joes.
The Stash holds an auction to help a friend sell his collection; relating to one of Spider-Man's enemies.
A customer tries to sell a gaming system with a twist; Ming buys another piece of his childhood.
The guys try to create their own comic book; Walt buys a signed issue of Creepy.
The guys play charades with a comic book twist; Walt has the chance to buy original artwork.
Ming plans a surprise for Walt's anniversary at The Stash; Ming learns the virtue of patience.
Lou Ferrigno gives Bryan a lesson on fitness; a customer wants to purchase a key comic by Frank Miller.
Walt and the guys are invited to an actual bat cave; a customer wants to sell his original Star Wars action figures.
The guys ask George Perez to help rebuild Mike's collection; vintage interactive comic books.
Ming has the chance to purchase an oversized toy from the '80s; taking a wife on the perfect date.
A fan sells a Mr. T backyard water game; Ming is inspired to have fun on a hot day; Walt risks the shop's street credibility.
The guys bid on derelict storage units in hopes of striking it rich; Walt finds a fellow Elfquest fanatic.
A fan of "The Dukes of Hazzard" stops by to show off his collection of memorabilia; Walt encounters his first "brony."
The guys travel to the Baltimore Comic Con to launch their comic book, "Cryptozoic Man"; Jeff works on a Saturday to fill in for Walt.
A customer buys a gift for his father's 75th birthday; the Stash throws a party for Superman's 75th birthday.
A woman is looking for an Uhura Mego doll from the '70s; an X-Men fan buys the first appearance of Phoenix.
Walt is inspired to form a bowling team; an ill-conceived action figure shows up.
Bored, Walt quizzes the guys on comic book trivia; a customer sells a Hellboy prop replica.
The Stash helps auction off the work of Mike Esposito; Walt buys a paper doll.
The guys have the opportunity to buy a replica of the '66 Batcycle; a collection of Marvel fan magazines from the '70s.
A young man wants to appraise his collection; Walt buys Wayne Gretzky memorabilia.
Jason Mewes invites the guys to a Renaissance fair; a customer brings in a valuable item.
Kevin Smith sends his daughter to The Stash to learn how to be a clerk; a customer wants to sell rare and unusual "Rocky" action figures.
A returning customer brings in a toy that Walt always coveted; an aspiring student brings in an autographed book.
Walt challenges the others to perform stand-up routines; a collector brings in Marvel Comics from the 1960s.
The guys agree to baby-sit a friend's daughter for the afternoon; an Indiana Jones superfan has items from the films.
Walt and the others attend BronyCon, a convention for "My Little Pony" fans; a customer wants to sell a Godzilla board game from the 1970s.
Walt considers buying the hand and footprints of Adam West and Burt Ward; a rare set of Star Wars comic strips.
The co-creator of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, Kevin Eastman, brings in early sketches of the turtles.
Walt has a business proposition for original Ghostbuster, Ernie Hudson; a customer wants to sell cartoon shampoo bottles from the 1960s.
Adam West visits and a race between the Batmobile and Black Beauty ensues; a customer sells the first appearance of Rocket Raccoon.
Artist Neal Adams and writer Denny O'Neil visit the Stash; the guys see a set of 50-year-old Batman night lights.
Butch Patrick (Eddie Munster) stops by the Stash; a never officially released rare Star Wars action figure.
Kevin's assistant, Ashley, learns about comic book retail at the Stash; pro wrestlers want to sell their comic.
Darryl McDaniels of Run-DMC brings his new comic to the Stash; the guys look at a Marvel Silver Age number one issue.
Billy Dee Williams stops by the store to win the Millennium Falcon the same way Lando lost it: a high-stakes card game.
Jason Mewes hangs out and plays clerk at the Stash; Walt wants to acquire a mysterious recreation of comic book art.
The guys attend a KISS concert; Walt lives out his childhood dream of meeting Gene Simmons; Ming considers buying an arcade cabinet.
Peter Mayhew ("Chewbacca") judges a Wookiee contest at the Stash; one of the hottest comic books of the 1990s.
Mike flies in the Batcopter to celebrate fifteen years at the Secret Stash; the guys look at one of the hottest books of the '90s.
Kevin talks comics with actor William Shatner; Walt covets a Mego doll that has unique packaging.
The guys and Bryan visit a "Jaws" museum; super-powered toilet paper comes through.
The guys are prompted to reconsider their preparations for the apocalypse by a zombie comic; an eccentric collector wants Walt's help.
Stan Lee helps a customer who is experiencing a comics crisis; a customer buys a classic issue of Fantastic Four.
Secret Stash employees audition with Walt and Bryan for a role in the claymation film they are making with Brian Quinn.
Comics artist, John Romita, Jr., draws an original piece for the Stash; Bryan shows interest in an Evel Knievel toy from his childhood.
Inspired by an old friend, the guys wear cowboy hats, and celebrate the old Wild West; a customer is searching for an iconic comic from the '80s.
Artist Jim Lee shares tales from the world of comics on the podcast; a comic book brings wedding bells to the Stash.
When Ming gets a selfie stick, he tries to go viral by filming the Stash; Walt examines bootleg toys of an '80s blockbuster.
Jason Mewes brings his infant daughter to the Stash to meet everyone; a customer sells comic book Slurpee cups.
Real-life superhero, Phoenix Jones, visits the store and patrols Red Bank with the guys; Walt reminisces about a Batman playset.
Walt and the boys go on a trip to cross off a bucket-list item; four key Spider-Man issues come to the Stash.
The Stash sponsors a blood drive at the shop with the help of horror queen Elvira; the boys discuss the joys of "Mystery Science Theater 3000."
When a vintage 1980s Pac-Man game lands on the counter, Ming prepares for battle; a rare Beatles board game excites the guys.
KITT from "Knight Rider" pulls up to the Stash; a rare Green Arrow Mego figure and Archie Bunker's grandson.
Lindsay Wagner ("The Bionic Woman") stops in for a Silver Surfer item; Jem and Ghostbusters toys spark another round of banter.
Ming and a customer joust over the price of Batman 111; Wolverine becomes the largest statue to ever enter the Stash.
Kevin and Harley visit for the Yoga Hosers premiere; Ming becomes a lead villain with help from a special-effects makeup legend.
Members of the 501st Legion of Stormtroopers invade the Stash looking for new recruits; the fate of a vintage Ewok playset.
Ralph Macchio seeks a rare "Karate Kid" playset; Ming gets an unforgettable lesson; Walt gets excited about a Mechagodzilla.
The guys prepare for a maritime adventure when the Batboat docks in Red Bank; Batman's first appearance.
Jason Mewes inserts himself into transactions involving a Deadshot statue and a vintage Death Star Space Station.
Actress Katrina Law ("Arrow") wants a copy of Batman 232; old school items involving Popeye, Dynomutt and Pogs.
Walt steps into the ring with a customer over an original Rock 'Em Sock 'Em Robots game; a rare piece of original Sal Buscema art.
Marky Ramone shares his artwork and bonds with Walt over robots; a King Kong item from 1975.

The last two standing compete for $10,000 in a Breakfast in Bed-themed Cake Showdown. With judges Jemma Wilson, Duff Goldman and Yolanda Gampp

Jamie’s cooking up sesame seared tuna, a mouthwatering meal in minutes, and messy meatball buns—feel-good family food that’s fast and loaded with flavor—followed by his irresistibly gooey Chocolate Rye Cookies, home baking at breakneck speed.

Family recipes are an eternal source of happiness for Italians, and in this episode Silvia shares her family’s - most cherished meals. A rich sausage stew on a  bed of soft polenta. A timeless family favourite, Pasta with Potato and - Provola. And direct from Italy via webcam, Silvia’ Mum helps her bake Abruzzese style waffles.

In San Antonio, Jess makes her first visit to Reese Bros BBQ to try their indulgent queso fundido sausage. Bringing it back to her own grill, she shows viewers how to reimagine the gooey, smoky dish at home, with an easy, shareable dish packed with bold Texas flavour.

At Helberg Barbecue in Waco, Jess discovers the magic of smoke-fried chicken, where low-and-slow meets hot oil for maximum flavour and crunch. Back home, she demystifies the process, showing how to achieve that signature smoky, crispy finish without complicated equipment.

programmes.t: Chuck And The First Peoples Kitchen
programmes.d: Chuck travels to Mashteuiatsh where he hunts and fields dress a moose. He meets Frederick Raphaël, an avid hunter who takes Chuck to a hunting journey in the woods.

programmes.t: Chuck And The First Peoples Kitchen
programmes.d: In Wikwemikong, Chuck learns how to ice fish the traditional way with a jigger. He meets Anishinabee Russell Trudeau who is an experienced fisherman passionate about ice fishing.
Jamie’s cooking up Cajun steak, smoky baked beans, and collard greens; plus chicken tikka and lentil, spinach, and naan salad.

In San Antonio, Jess makes her first visit to Reese Bros BBQ to try their indulgent queso fundido sausage. Bringing it back to her own grill, she shows viewers how to reimagine the gooey, smoky dish at home, with an easy, shareable dish packed with bold Texas flavour.

The Chocolate Queen returns for another season of indulgence! Kirsten kicks things off with a decadent chocolate layered cake and her irresistible butterscotch almond bars. She also takes on a 10-minute dessert challenge and shares creative tips for transforming leftover cakes into delightful new treats.

A feast for dessert lovers awaits in this episode! Kirsten brings Italian-inspired magic to the kitchen with her chocolate custard tarts, simple yet stunning pistachio bark, and her expert guide to crafting the ultimate raspberry cake.

An unconventional pairing of cherries and halibut has the Chefs questioning one home cook’s ability to please a crowd, and Chef Jae-Anthony Dougan spices things up with the Caribbean flavours in his fridge.

Jamie cooks up quick Asian fishcakes with a brilliant tip for a sweet and spicy glaze, then his Speedy Lemony Courgette Linguine; perfect at the end of a hectic day. Sticky lamb chops are a knockout one-pan dish with a fast-track to incredible flavor.

Bread is sacred in Italy, it’s there at almost every family meal and should never be wasted. Today Silvia shares 3 - delicious ways to repurpose leftover bread, starting with a rustic, healthy Orecchiette Pasta, a baked fish dish with - roasted bread and a dessert so spectacular you wont believe its made with stale bread.

Jamie's recipes feature lucky squid 'n' prawns spicy vegetable noodle broth, plus veggie chili, crunchy tortilla, and avocado salad.
Jenn visits northern Saskatchewan to learn how to catch, clean and cook walleye.

Join host Sarah Sharratt as she begins her culinary adventure in rural France. She visits a traditional festival that celebrates all things mushroom and gets put to work at her local cheesemaker. With the kids away, Sarah prepares a date night menu for her husband that includes a cream of mushroom soup, a Provence-inspired roast chicken, and mini pear and ginger cakes.

Host Sarah Sharratt discovers that one of the most famous ingredients of the Périgord region of France is walnuts. After a visit to a local walnut farm and nut oil press, Sarah uses these versatile nuts to make a creamy walnut ravioli, a stuffed and rolled leg of lamb, and a walnut tart inspired by her local bakery.
All four home cooks pull from childhood memories to make their crowd-pleasers, and Chef Meeru Dhalwala baits everyone into pushing their limits with the fish sauce in her fridge.

Jamie cooks up his Tender Lamb Shoulder, an epic sharing feast that’s super-quick to prep, with an easy cheat for incredible flavor. Next up: super green spaghetti, a speedy veggie pasta that will blow your mind.

Bakers from Sacremento, California, Greensboro, North Carolina and Mount Holly, North Carolina compete in a speedy elimination round with Grapefruit as the mystery ingredient. The last two standing compete for $10,000 in a Breakfast in Bed-themed Cake Showdown. With judges Jemma Wilson, Duff Goldman and Yolanda Gampp
Jamie's recipes feature lucky squid 'n' prawns spicy vegetable noodle broth, plus veggie chili, crunchy tortilla, and avocado salad.
Jenn visits northern Saskatchewan to learn how to catch, clean and cook walleye.

Join host Sarah Sharratt as she begins her culinary adventure in rural France. She visits a traditional festival that celebrates all things mushroom and gets put to work at her local cheesemaker. With the kids away, Sarah prepares a date night menu for her husband that includes a cream of mushroom soup, a Provence-inspired roast chicken, and mini pear and ginger cakes.

Host Sarah Sharratt discovers that one of the most famous ingredients of the Périgord region of France is walnuts. After a visit to a local walnut farm and nut oil press, Sarah uses these versatile nuts to make a creamy walnut ravioli, a stuffed and rolled leg of lamb, and a walnut tart inspired by her local bakery.
All four home cooks pull from childhood memories to make their crowd-pleasers, and Chef Meeru Dhalwala baits everyone into pushing their limits with the fish sauce in her fridge.

Jamie cooks up his Tender Lamb Shoulder, an epic sharing feast that’s super-quick to prep, with an easy cheat for incredible flavor. Next up: super green spaghetti, a speedy veggie pasta that will blow your mind.

For Italians guests are always the best reason for a feast! With some friends coming to visit, Silvia’s is out to impress, making one of her Nonna’s most delicious, crowdpleasing pasta feasts. Plus a delicate ricotta and semolina cake that is a true show stopper, and not to be out doneSilvia’s friend Rose shares an old Sicilian savoury doughnut recipe
Raymond Blanc shares his archive of recipes and introduces the nation to his favourite dishes which have featured on the menus across his restaurants.
Mena restaurant-hops with friends Lilly Singh and Laura Marano, indulging in elevated plant-based French pastries, “pastrami” sammies, Thai “chicken” wings, and unbelievable “carne” asada.
Jamie rustles up Asian fish, miso noodles, and crunchy veg. Then he cooks up ultimate pork tacos, spicy black beans, and avocado garden salad.
Fruit mousses are a staple in patisseries, and come in all sorts of colours and shapes. They can be a dessert on their own or part of a grand torte.

programmes.d: Chuck meets Captain Norbert Fontaine and his sons and embarks on a snow crab fishing sea adventure. Norbert is a very skilled captain from the Innu community Uashat Mak Mani-Utenam, who was one of the firsts Innu to receive his boat captain certificate.
A home cook attempts to turn a cheat meal into a crowd-pleaser in the first round, and Chef Danny Smiles spices things up with the za’atar in his fridge.

Jamie’s cooking up his high-speed Ginger Shakin’ Beef, teamed with one-minute-wonder veg, pak choi. Followed by crispy squid and smashed avo, an irresistible, impressive plate of food that’s a joy to make and a pleasure to share.

The art of cooking once and eating twice. Today Silvia makes some divine ricotta filled Italian crepes, and then using the leftover ingredients shows us how to create a rustic story pie from the North of Italy and a heart baked - pasta, Pasta Al Forno.
One home baker tries to go with the flow with a lava cake in the first round, and Chef Lynn Crawford hits a sweet spot with the Meyer lemons and honey in her pantry.

Claire gets a surprise proposal on a mountain hike with her boyfriend Joey but when they get separated, a rancher turns Claire’s head and a park ranger makes Joey see they’re made for each other.

Lily, a museum curator, discovers a painting that looks just like her and is sent to find where the painting came from and who painted it. She tracks the painting down to the post office it was sent from in Ireland. There she meets William and Saoirse, a brother-sister duo who run the post, and who offer her help and friendship on her quest. But William knows more than he's letting on. Will he reveal what he knows if it risks his growing relationship--and mutual love--with Lily?

Four foster kids on the run find shelter in a mansion after rescuing a stray dog. When they uncover a robbery plot, they risk everything to stop it—earning a second chance at family and love by Christmas.

When her truck breaks down in the mid-west, Sara is invited to park her camper on a family ranch while her truck is repaired. She meets two brothers, who are as different as night and day. The brothers are instantly smitten with Sara and soon she begins to have feelings for them both. The last thing Sara expected to find was romance on the ranch.

At Christmas the daughter of an ice sculptor wishes the ice princess he carved would come to life. After her wish is fulfilled, Jade, the ice princess, must convince her scultpor to accept her or she will turn back into ice.
Secret aspirations between a failed restaurateur and a celebrity chef threaten their blossoming Christmas romance.

Jodie Brown was born with a physical disability and lives with her mother on a run down old farm. Jodie's dream is to own and ride a horse and even eventually compete in a horse show. Bridgett Van Heusen, lives a complete different life. She lives on a beautiful farm and has her own horse and competes in horse shows. These two girls path's cross and the story follows the success of one and the failure of the other.

Brielle has always believed the ocean floor is full of treasures just waiting to be found. Over the years she has dived to find coins, lost jewelry and more in the waters of Tahiti. Instead of profiting from them, she loves reuniting people with their lost valuables. When she finds a class ring and returns it to Marcus, a handsome US Navy serviceman, Brielle soon discovers what has been missing in her life – a treasure of the heart.
A runaway bride does some soul-searching when she's trapped in a snowed-in cabin with her grandmother and an old flame at Christmas.

Pediatric specialist Tasha Miller is caring for two young patients plus one sinfully gorgeous royal. She knew Prince Alexander at boarding school long ago and thinks he's still a self-absorbed, incorrigible heartbreaker. But when Tasha sees him with the children, his kindness and caring nature shine through so brightly that Dr. Tasha can't help but be attracted.

programmes.t: Christmas With A Prince: Becoming Royal
programmes.d: Its Christmas again and Dr Tasha is on her way to meet Prince Alexander in St. Savarre. Though this is a happy time it is also a very stressful as a treaty is being negotiated between St. Savarre and Vandelien. When Tasha arrives, Alex surprises her by asking for her hand in marriage. She accepts and they immediately begin planning the wedding. When Princess Miranda finds out she is not happy and concocts a plan to put a halt to this fairy-tale.

When a 1969 Camaro with bad body roll is delivered to the shop, Kevin and Willie tackle the suspension to help it perform better on the track.
Kevin and Willie build a new bed for an ongoing 1973 truck project before solving some issues with the hub assembly on a hefty F-350.
Federated Auto Parts send Willie B. and Kevin a Jeep Wrangler to outfit with a new Dana 44 and a few other upgrades for a lucky winner.
With a powerful Dodge Challenger in the shop for maintenance and performance upgrades, Kevin and Willie can’t resist adding on a new exhaust for the owner as well.
When Willie and Kevin find a 1953 M37 sitting in a friend’s garage next to a Cummins 4BT and all the parts needed for an engine swap, they volunteer to provide the labor.

The guys have a sweet 1970 Chevelle in the shop with a worn-out interior and a problematic cowl induction system seal.  Plus, Kevin tackles the daunting task of rebuilding an infamous Rochester Quadrajet Carburetor.

Willie stumbles across a beautiful 1966 Impala, but its beauty is only skin-deep.  Under the hood are rusty headers, a grimy engine block, and a host of other needed repairs.  It’s up to Willie and Kevin to restore this classic to its former glory.
A rare 1970 Charger and a 1970 Barracuda 383 are featured.
A 1968 Charger, a 1970 Challenger R/T, and a 1969 Charger are featured.
A 1972 Dodge Charger is restored.
A 1969 Road Runner is featured.
Work on a 1972 Dodge Charger is continued.
The story about the 1972 Charger is briefly revisited, and past work leading to its completion is also revisited. Work on the 1972 Dodge Charger is completed and revealed to the owners.
The 1970 Plymouth Superbird work is resumed, and the 1970 Charger R/T collision repair is completed. The 1970 Barracuda Convertible's 383 2bbl. V8 is assembled and painted.

A secret is accidentally revealed by Mark. Mark and Daren visit the local AAMCO Transmissions to watch the overhaul of the 1970 Barracuda Convertible's 727 Automatic Transmission, and then the Barracuda has its A/C box and instrument panel installed. The 1970 Superbird assembly nears completion.
Automotive parts supplier Tony D'Agostino of Tony's Parts helps the shop get organized, and Mark tests his Mopar knowledge against Tony's. Work on a 1970 Plymouth Superbird is completed.

The 1970 Superbird's restoration and story is recapped, and the Hills visit the shop to take delivery of the car, along with its original owner. Mike and Michael Hill drive the Superbird on a cross county trip home to South Carolina.
With the 1970 Plymouth Superbird done and safely driven home, Mark is asked to restore a 1969 Daytona Charger. Due to its condition, Mark questions if it's practical and if it's even legal.
Just when things couldn't get more stressful, Mark agrees to finally get the 1930 Chevy Coach fully restored by the end of the week. Meanwhile, Mark QC's the next cars in the process of resurrection.
See the complete 3-year restoration of Kimberly Cook's 1970 Barracuda Convertible: the body, paint, engine, and convertible top, culminating in Graveyard Carz' most emotional reveal to date.
New shop. New crew. An All-new Graveyard Carz! The ghouls tackle a 1970 Cuda.
Mark paints a Hemi Charger in his favorite Mopar color, burnt orange. AMD delivers the Phantom Cuda, and the ghouls finish the Dailey's 1970 Cuda 383, a project four years in the making.
The ghouls wrap up the 340 Cuda and install panels on the Hemi Charger. Mark trains Allysa on O.E.M. assembly line markings. The legendary red Plymouth Fury "Christine" visits the shop.
The ghouls have problems with after-market parts for the 400 Magnum V8. Allysa begins working in the shop, and two rare Mopars are disassembled
Mark's coffee addiction is spotlighted, and the ghouls work on a 1970 Challenger.
Work on a 1970 Cuda 340 is featured.

Nick Rutter showcases the products and process to restore the finish of a 10-year-old vehicle using a rotary and dual action polisher, protecting with a graphene ceramic coating and also restores the faded plastic trim.
Nick Rutter walks you through step-by-step on how to remove stubborn bug splatter from your vehicle along with tips and techniques for using a waterless wash as well as a clay bar.
Matt and Bruno are working on a 2006 Dodge Ram with a ton of problems…but why just make the repairs? Go better than stock!
Matt visits the Wheels for Hope Garage in Raleigh, NC and sees first hand how this organization is changing lives.
Matt and Bruno upgrade the Dana 35 rear end in a 2000 Jeep TJ to a much stronger Ford 8.8 one and do it for under $500.
Every light on your dashboard means something. Matt and Bruno diagnose and repair a vehicle that came to the shop to them with warning lights.
Nobody likes to fix a truck on the side of the road. That’s why there’s roadside assistance. Matt and Bruno take a stock F250 and turn it into a purpose-built Road Ranger.
With two days and a ton of truck parts anything can happen. Matt and Bruno put together build teams to see who can complete the toughest rig.
The Jeep Build-Off continues as the guys get a chance to finish their Jeeps and take them on a Geocaching race for all of the marbles.

Tony helps prep a quirky, rare British TVR for sale and makes a play for one of the most elusive Camaros ever built, the legendary ZL1. When Tony is offered a rust-free ’55 Chevy he knows it's a too good of a deal to pass up.

When a client puts out the call for a DeLorean, Tony finds two dramatically different contenders: one showroom-clean, the other frozen in time. It’s nostalgia versus perfection as Tony helps figure out what's the best route for his client to take.

Tony helps an owner move a custom Mercury to none other than Joe Zolper as a potential buyer. Then, a lead sends Tony to a dusty garage hiding a nearly untouched Porsche RS America with just 5,000 original miles.

Tony teams up with the Auto Archeologist, Ryan Brutt, to uncover one of the rarest Dodge Demons in existence. Then Tony follows the trail to make an offer on a movie-star, an Eleanor Mustang. With this deal, the sky's the limit!

Tony digs out a rare Mustang that's been hidden under dusty boxes for decades, but the owner has another surprise in store. Then Tony gets a chance to size up a Model A truck at an auction preview before he heads to the famous Spring Carlisle swap meet where there's rusty gold and an old Jeep waiting for him.

An iconic Hurst Oldsmobile emerges from years in storage and roars back to life in the shop. Meanwhile, a cold call takes Tony to a Chevelle project that creates more questions than it answers and the owner needs some help figuring out what to do with it.

Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can sup

Twenty-five years of hand building record-setting race cars is no easy task. But don’t tell that to Don Panoz who takes on Porsches and Ferraris with his laid back personality and a full-production facility that makes improvised versions of Americas V-8’s; Caffeine & Octane gets an exclusive look at an elusive man’s life long pursuit of everything Chevrolet.

Caffeine & Octane goes old school with Psycho Deville singer and pin striper Walt Richards. Richards has less than a week to hand paint his signature flames on a way cool ’50 Mercury. An introduction to Retrofit Lighting’s trickle down technology - from cars to motorcycles - that will revolutionize how bikes will see and be seen.

Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation is tested when over 100 VW’s, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattled into an event. The annual VW Invasion has swarmed C&O, bringing with it Bugs, Beetles, Buses and more by a very dedicated VW fan base.

Season 1 finishes on a high note when rapper, radio, and ATL TV personality Darian “Big Tigger” Morgan invites Caffeine & Octane into his home. Cameras look past his collection of 500 Michael Jordan shoes to focus their lenses on a one-off motorcycle the 6 – time NBA Champion gave to Tigger as a gift; A second to none, muscle car collection by one of the founders of Monster Energy gets toured by one of our hosts.

Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.
